title.zh: LeetCode · 一步一步想出来
title.en: LeetCode · Reason Your Way to the Solution

desc.en: Derive algorithms through small examples, predictions and counterexamples, then implement them in Python. First lesson: 2916, from subarrays to interval updates and lazy propagation.

title.zh: 寓言乘风，梦在舞动
title.en: Let Fable take Flight

desc.zh: 深夜的图书馆，两万四千页寓言乘风飞舞。Three.js 实时短片：建筑、纹理、钢琴与纸声全部由代码生成。
desc.en: A midnight library where 24,000 pages of fable take to the air. A real-time Three.js short film; architecture, textures, piano and paper sounds are all generated in code.

title.zh: 稀缺会搬家
title.en: Scarcity Moves

desc.zh: 十个经济学的基本道理，每个配一个可以动手的小模型；再用它们推演 AI 普及之后，工作、收入和稀缺会怎样变化。
desc.en: Ten core ideas of economics, each with a hands-on model, then applied to what happens to work, income and scarcity once AI is everywhere.

title.zh: 数字没有说谎，结论却错了
title.en: Every Number Was True, and the Conclusion Was Still Wrong

desc.zh: 九种让真数字推出假结论的方式：均值回归、小样本、幸存者、多重比较、辛普森悖论、基础比率、相对风险、长尾平均和古德哈特定律。每一种都配一个小模型，先亲手造出错觉，再亲手关掉它。
desc.en: Nine ways true numbers lead to false conclusions: regression to the mean, small samples, survivorship, many comparisons, Simpson's paradox, base rates, relative risk, long-tailed averages and Goodhart's law. Each comes with a small model: produce the illusion yourself, then switch it off.

title.zh: 身体是怎么稳住的
title.en: How the Body Keeps Things Steady

desc.zh: 进和出一直在变，身体却把血糖、体温、药量守在很窄的范围里。九个可以拖动的模型：半衰期与平台、酒精、血糖反馈、发烧、治疗窗、心脏、抗生素和群体免疫。
desc.en: Inputs and outputs never stop changing, yet the body keeps glucose, temperature and drug levels in narrow ranges. Nine models you can push: half-life and plateau, alcohol, glucose feedback, fever, the therapeutic window, the heart, antibiotics and herd immunity.

title.zh: 一部手机里的十个道理
title.en: Ten Ideas Inside One Phone

desc.zh: 定位、朝向、触摸、拍照、显示、压缩、上网、纠错、切换、电量：每个功能都是一次对极小量的测量，加上一个把信号从噪声里分出来的办法。十章，十个可以动手的模型。
desc.en: Location, orientation, touch, camera, screen, compression, radio, error correction, handover and battery: each feature measures something tiny and uses one trick to pull signal out of noise. Ten chapters, each with a model you can push around.

title.zh: 钱是从哪里来的
title.en: Where Money Comes From

desc.zh: 你账户里的数字不是金库里的钞票。它是谁的欠条、怎样被贷款造出来、为什么银行会被挤兑、为什么每年能买的东西少一点。八个可以拖动的模型。
desc.en: The number in your bank account is not a pile of notes in a vault. Whose IOU it is, how loans create it, why banks can be run, and why it buys a little less each year, in eight models you can push around.

title.zh: 同一批选票，不同的赢家 · 投票规则与公平
title.en: Same Ballots, Different Winner · Voting Rules and Fairness

desc.zh: 同一批选民的偏好，换一种数票的方法就换一个赢家。十一个可以动手的模型：搅局者、中位选民、多数循环、策略投票、阿罗定理、阿拉巴马悖论、画选区、陪审团定理。
desc.en: The same voters' preferences, counted another way, crown another winner. Eleven hands-on models: spoilers, the median voter, majority cycles, strategic voting, Arrow's theorem, the Alabama paradox, district lines and the jury theorem.

title.zh: 一堆开关是怎么学会算数的
title.en: How a Pile of Switches Learned to Do Arithmetic

desc.zh: 只用一种开或关的开关，逐门搭出逻辑门、加法器、记忆、时钟，直到一台能照程序做乘法的 16 字节小机器；每个电路都在页面里逐门模拟。
desc.en: From one on/off switch, build gates, an adder, memory, a clock and finally a 16-byte machine that multiplies by following a program; every circuit is simulated gate by gate on the page.

title.zh: 黑洞到底是什么
title.en: What Is a Black Hole, Really?

desc.zh: 把一团质量压进 2GM/c² 以内会怎样？九个可以拖动的模型：逃逸速度追上光速、黑洞不会“吸”（除非你进到 3 r_s 以内）、相对论轨道、潮汐撕裂、时间变慢、比视界大的影子，以及恒星轨道和引力波这些证据。
desc.en: What happens when a mass is squeezed inside 2GM/c²? Nine models you can push: escape speed reaching light speed, why black holes don't suck (until you are within 3 r_s), relativistic orbits, tidal stretching, slowed clocks, a shadow bigger than the horizon, and the evidence from stellar orbits and gravitational waves.

title.zh: 疫苗是怎么保护人的
title.en: How Vaccines Protect You and the People Around You

desc.zh: 疫苗里没有杀病毒的药，它凭什么让你少生病，又凭什么护住打不了针的婴儿？七个可以拖动的模型：和病毒赛跑、第二针为什么又快又多、防感染与防重症、“95% 有效”的算法、病例里为什么多数打过疫苗、需要多少人接种、保护消退。
desc.en: A vaccine contains no drug that kills the virus, so how does it keep you from getting ill, and how does it protect a baby too young for the jab? Seven models you can push: the race against the virus, why the second dose is faster and bigger, infection versus severe disease, what "95% effective" means, why most cases can be vaccinated people, the coverage needed, and waning.

title.zh: 一点点二氧化碳 · 地球为什么会变暖
title.en: A Little CO₂ · Why the Planet Warms

desc.zh: 空气里每一万个分子只有四个多是二氧化碳，它怎么能让整个地球变暖？七个可以拖动的模型：能量收支、一层毯子、越高越冷、“已经饱和”、反馈、敏感度区间和海洋的拖延。只讲物理，不做预测。
desc.en: Only about four in every ten thousand air molecules are CO₂, so how can it warm a whole planet? Seven models you can push: the energy budget, one blanket layer, emitting from higher up, "already saturated", feedbacks, the sensitivity range and the ocean's lag. Physics only, no projections.

title.zh: 天为什么是蓝的
title.en: Why Is the Sky Blue?

desc.zh: 天是蓝的，落日是红的，云是白的，火星的天是黄褐的。九个可以拖动的模型：光子穿过空气、1/λ⁴、天空光的光谱、眼睛为什么不认紫、落日、整片天空、从分子到云滴的颗粒、火星的天空，以及多次散射和臭氧。
desc.en: The sky is blue, sunsets are red, clouds are white and the Martian sky is butterscotch. Nine models you can push: photons crossing the air, 1/λ⁴, the skylight spectrum, why the eye doesn't see violet, sunset, the whole sky, particles from molecules to cloud drops, the sky of Mars, and multiple scattering and ozone.

title.zh: 每个月的房贷，钱到底还到哪儿去了
title.en: Where Does Your Mortgage Payment Actually Go?

desc.zh: 一笔房贷每个月的钱，一部分付利息，一部分减本金。八个可以拖动的模型：名义利率与实际利率、月供公式、还款表、等额本金与等额本息、提前还款、利率变动、分期手续费的真实年利率、通胀与机会成本。
desc.en: Each month's mortgage payment splits into interest and principal. Eight models you can push: nominal and effective rates, the payment formula, the amortisation schedule, equal-principal versus equal-payment, prepaying, a rate change, the true annual rate of a flat-fee instalment plan, and inflation and opportunity cost.

title.zh: 酱豆腐为什么好吃
title.en: Why Fermented Tofu Tastes Good

desc.zh: 豆腐几乎没有味道，长霉、加盐、放几个月却变得很鲜。松花蛋里没有微生物，为什么也走到了差不多的地方？七个可以拖动的模型：切链、两种酶、鲜味相乘、盐和水分活度、气味活度值、碱渗进蛋里、稀释后还剩什么味。
desc.en: Tofu has almost no taste, yet mould, salt and a few months make it rich and savoury. A century egg gets somewhere similar with no microbes at all. Seven models you can push: cutting protein chains, two kinds of enzyme, umami synergy, salt and water activity, odour activity values, alkali soaking into an egg, and what you still smell after dilution.

title.zh: 酱油是怎么酿出来的
title.en: How Soy Sauce Gets Its Flavor

desc.zh: 黄豆、小麦、盐和水，单独都不鲜、不香、不黑，放在一起半年却成了酱油；也有的酱油几天就做出来。六个可以拖动的模型：曲床发热、小麦带来的糖、盐水里乳酸菌和酵母的接力、颜色和温度、瓶子上的氨基酸态氮、一勺里的钠。
desc.en: Soybeans, wheat, salt and water are each bland, pale and odourless, yet half a year together turns them into soy sauce; some soy sauce is made in days. Six models you can push: a heating koji bed, the sugar wheat brings, the hand-over from lactic bacteria to yeast in brine, colour and temperature, the amino-nitrogen number on the label, and the sodium in a spoonful.

title.zh: 混合注意力是怎么“记住”长文的
title.en: How Hybrid Attention Models Remember

desc.zh: 为什么标准大模型读得越长，内存账单就按长度线性变厚？从 KV Cache、矩阵结合律、快权重容量上限、Delta 擦写规则、Gated DeltaNet 遗忘门到 3:1 混合注意力与屋顶线吞吐，用九个可动手模型一路讲透。
desc.en: Why does a standard LLM memory bill grow linearly with context length? Walk through KV cache accounting, matrix associativity, fast-weight capacity limits, the delta rule, Gated DeltaNet, 3:1 hybrids, and roofline decode speed in nine live models.

title.zh: 为什么计算一直在等内存
title.en: Why Compute Waits for Memory

desc.zh: 处理器每秒能算上千万亿次，为什么运行起来却常常大部分时间都在等内存？十个交互模型带你从五级流水线、缓存模拟器、矩阵分块、内存墙与利特尔法则，一路走到屋顶线模型、大模型推理和 HBM4 前沿。
desc.en: Processors can execute quadrillions of operations per second, yet spend most of their time waiting for memory. Ten interactive models trace the bottleneck from a 5-stage pipeline and set-associative cache to tiled matmul, Little's Law, the Roofline model, LLM inference, and HBM4.

title.zh: NVMe 为什么这么快
title.en: Why NVMe Is So Fast

desc.zh: 同样是闪存颗粒，为什么换上 NVMe 协议和 PCIe 通道就能快出好几倍？八个交互模型带你从延迟拆解、总线宽度、64K 并行队列、环形门铃、NAND 多通道、写放大与 Trim、轮询与中断，一路走到 PCIe 6.0 与 GPUDirect 前沿。
desc.en: Why does switching from SATA/AHCI to NVMe over PCIe multiply storage speed? Eight interactive models trace the shift from latency breakdown, bus lanes, and 64K parallel queues to ring buffers, NAND channels, write amplification, polling, and PCIe 6.0 GPUDirect.

title.zh: 硬盘里到底是什么
title.en: What a Drive Is Made Of

desc.zh: 机械硬盘和固态硬盘里装的东西完全不同，电脑却用同一套方式读它们。八个可以拖动的模型：编了号的扇区、寻道和转动、叠瓦磁道、闪存单元里的电压层、纠错码和寿命、闪存翻译层、接口与协议的分层地图、一次读取的时间花在哪。
desc.en: A hard disk and a solid-state drive contain completely different things, yet the computer reads both the same way. Eight models you can push: numbered sectors, seek and rotation, shingled tracks, voltage levels in a flash cell, error correction and lifetime, the flash translation layer, a layered map of connectors and protocols, and where the time of one read goes.

title.zh: SATA 为什么用了二十多年
title.en: Why SATA Has Lasted Over Twenty Years

desc.zh: 一根七针的数据线、一套 2004 年定下的主机接口，为什么到 2026 年还接在最大的机械硬盘上？七个可以拖动的模型：并行总线的时序预算、8b/10b 编码器、一条读命令的帧、旋转盘片上的 NCQ、链路省电、端口倍增器、机械硬盘和 6 Gb/s 的距离。
desc.en: Why is a seven-pin data cable, with a host interface fixed in 2004, still what the largest hard drives plug into in 2026? Seven models you can drag: the timing budget of a parallel bus, an 8b/10b encoder, the frames of one read command, NCQ on a spinning platter, link power states, a port multiplier, and how far a hard disk is from 6 Gb/s.

title.zh: 服务器硬盘为什么用 SAS
title.en: Why Server Drives Use SAS

desc.zh: 同样的盘片，SATA 版和 SAS 版装进机房，为什么服务器偏偏要 SAS？七个可以拖动的模型：一条 SCSI 命令的字节、一次读要开几次连接、两条路径的可用度、扩展器后面的扇出、宽端口的四条道、T10 PI 的 8 字节校验、24G 的纠错码。
desc.en: The same platters ship as SATA and as SAS drives; why do servers insist on SAS? Seven models you can drag: the bytes of one SCSI command, how many connections one read opens, the availability of two paths, fan-out behind an expander, the four lanes of a wide port, the 8-byte T10 PI check, and the error-correcting code of 24G.

title.zh: 移动硬盘为什么跑不满
title.en: Why a USB Drive Never Hits Its Label

desc.zh: 一块能跑 7 GB/s 的 NVMe 固态装进 USB 硬盘盒，为什么只剩几百 MB/s 到两三 GB/s？包装上的 Gen 2×2、40Gbps 说的是什么？九个可以拖动的模型：USB 2.0 的微帧、从名字到线速、Bulk-Only 的一问一答、UASP 的队列、桥接链条上的瓶颈、发热降速、雷电与 USB4 的 PCIe 隧道、U 盘里的几颗闪存。
desc.en: Why does a 7 GB/s NVMe SSD in a USB enclosure measure a few hundred MB/s to two or three GB/s, and what do “Gen 2×2” and “40Gbps” on the box mean? Nine models you can drag: the USB 2.0 microframe, from a name to the line rate, Bulk-Only’s one-at-a-time exchange, UASP’s queue, the bottleneck along the bridge chain, thermal throttling, the PCIe tunnel of Thunderbolt and USB4, and the few dies inside a flash drive.

title.zh: 隔着网线的硬盘
title.en: Drives Across a Wire

desc.zh: 硬盘插在别的机器里，你的电脑为什么能把它当成自己的盘？NAS 和 SAN 差在哪，数据中心为什么把 NVMe 搬到网线上？九个可以拖动的模型：改一个字节的三种代价、小文件和往返时间、iSCSI 的 R2T、光纤通道的信用、每一跳的延迟账、丢包的代价、NVMe-oF 的消息、两条路径的排队、三副本和纠删码。
desc.en: Why can your computer use a disk that sits in another machine as if it were its own? How do NAS and SAN differ, and why do data centres put NVMe on the network? Nine models you can drag: what changing one byte costs at three levels, small files and round trips, iSCSI's R2T, Fibre Channel credits, the latency of each hop, the cost of a lost packet, NVMe-oF's messages, queueing on two paths, and replication versus erasure coding.

title.zh: PCIe 为什么能一代一代翻倍
title.en: Why PCIe Keeps Doubling

desc.zh: 显卡、固态、网卡都插在 PCIe 上。这条总线二十多年里速度翻了六次，靠的是什么？一次读写在线上到底发生了什么？十个可以拖动的模型：链路协商、TLP 包头、信用流控、ACK/NAK 重发、开机枚举、MSI 中断、走线损耗、PAM4 眼图、FEC 和 FLIT。
desc.en: Graphics cards, SSDs and network cards all plug into PCIe. Its speed has doubled six times in over twenty years: how, and what actually happens on the wire during one read or write? Ten models you can drag: link negotiation, TLP headers, credit flow control, ACK/NAK replay, enumeration, MSI interrupts, trace loss, PAM4 eyes, FEC and FLITs.

title.zh: 电脑里的零件是怎么连起来的
title.en: How the Parts of a Computer Are Wired Together

desc.zh: CPU、内存、显卡、硬盘、USB 口，各自走的是哪条路？为什么早年的电脑是一根大家共用的总线，今天却变成一张点对点的网？八个可以拖动的模型和八张结构图：PCI 总线的时间账、反射波与负载、北桥的汇合点、两路服务器的远近内存、芯片组上行链路、片上环形与网格、芯粒之间的能耗、I²C 上拉电阻。
desc.en: Which path do the CPU, memory, graphics card, drives and USB ports each take? Why were early computers built around one bus everyone shared, and why is today's machine a web of point-to-point links? Eight models you can drag and eight structure diagrams: the PCI bus's time budget, reflected waves and loading, the northbridge as a meeting point, near and far memory in a two-socket server, the chipset uplink, rings and meshes on a die, energy between chiplets, and I²C pull-up resistors.

title.zh: 雷电接口是怎么工作的
title.en: How Thunderbolt Works

desc.zh: 一根 USB-C 线，为什么能同时带显示器、网卡、硬盘和充电，还能一台接一台串下去？雷电和 USB4 到底是什么关系？八个可以拖动的模型：CC 线上的分压、带校验的 4 字节包头、一条链路怎么分给几条隧道、菊花链、PAM3 与 3+1 非对称、显示器要多少带宽、PD 怎么谈出 140 瓦、IOMMU 按页开门。
desc.en: Why can one USB-C cable carry a monitor, a network adapter, a drive and charging at once, and chain one device after another? How do Thunderbolt and USB4 relate? Eight models you can drag: the CC divider, the 4-byte header with its check, how one link is shared among tunnels, the daisy chain, PAM3 and the 3+1 split, what a monitor needs, how PD negotiates 140 W, and the IOMMU's page-sized doors.

title.zh: CPU 的三级缓存是怎么工作的
title.en: How a CPU's Three Levels of Cache Work

desc.zh: 内存要等几十纳秒，CPU 一纳秒能做好几件事。几十 KB 到几十 MB 的缓存怎样让它大部分时候不用等？为什么分三级、每级为什么是现在这个大小？十个在真实地址序列上跑的缓存模型：地址怎么拆、相联度与三种缺失、LRU 与 RRIP、写回与写缓冲、包含与排他、L1 的容量上限、预取、MESI 与伪共享、追指针的延迟台阶。
desc.en: Memory takes tens of nanoseconds and a CPU does several things every nanosecond. How do caches of tens of kilobytes to tens of megabytes keep it from waiting most of the time? Why three levels, and why is each the size it is? Ten cache models run on real address traces: splitting an address, associativity and the three kinds of miss, LRU and RRIP, write-back and write buffers, inclusive and exclusive levels, the limit on L1 size, prefetching, MESI and false sharing, and the latency staircase of a pointer chase.

title.zh: CPU 是怎么运行一个程序的
title.en: How a CPU Runs a Program

desc.zh: 你写的一行代码，最后怎么变成 CPU 里一拍一拍的动作？同一个程序，为什么换一种写法、换一颗 CPU，速度能差好几倍？从指令集这份合同讲起：RISC-V 的寄存器和六种指令格式、把一个循环手工翻译成机器码、单周期数据通路和它的关键路径、五级流水线、数据冒险与转发、分支的代价、性能铁律、x86 怎么在内部拆成小操作，以及 RVA23、Armv9.8、APX 这些 2026 年的前沿。每个模型都是真的：汇编器、指令解释器、逐拍的流水线模拟器。
desc.en: How does a line of code become clock-by-clock work inside a CPU, and why can the same program run several times faster with different code or a different CPU? Starting from the instruction set as a contract: RISC-V registers and its six instruction formats, hand-compiling a loop to machine code, the single-cycle datapath and its longest path, the five-stage pipeline, data hazards and forwarding, the cost of branches, the iron law of performance, how x86 splits instructions into micro-ops, and the 2026 frontier (RVA23, Armv9.8, APX). Every model is real: an assembler, an instruction interpreter and a cycle-by-cycle pipeline simulator.

title.zh: 虚拟内存是怎么工作的
title.en: How Virtual Memory Works

desc.zh: 每个程序都以为自己独占一整块从 0 开始的内存，几十个程序却挤在同一条内存里。CPU 每读一个字节都要先翻译地址，为什么还不慢？十一个可以动手的模型：连续分配与外部碎片、页表的大小、x86-64 四级页表逐位走一遍、TLB 与它的覆盖范围、页表遍历缓存、大页、缺页的代价、FIFO 与 LRU 与时钟算法、写时复制、PCID 与 KPTI、虚拟机的二维页表。
desc.en: Every program believes it has a whole memory to itself, starting at address 0, while dozens of programs share the same physical memory. The CPU translates an address before every byte it reads; why is that not slow? Eleven hands-on models: contiguous allocation and external fragmentation, the size of a page table, an x86-64 four-level walk bit by bit, the TLB and its reach, the page-walk cache, huge pages, the cost of a page fault, FIFO, LRU and the clock algorithm, copy-on-write, PCID and KPTI, and the two-dimensional walk inside a virtual machine.

title.zh: CPU 是怎么猜着往前跑的
title.en: How a CPU Guesses Ahead

desc.zh: 一条分支要等十几拍才知道往哪走，CPU 却不等：它先猜，猜对了白赚，猜错了推倒重来。它怎么猜得这么准？为什么一颗 CPU 能同时有几百条指令在路上？这种猜测又为什么会泄露秘密？十个模型：1 位与 2 位计数器、排序数组、gshare、TAGE、返回栈、超标量、寄存器重命名与重排序缓冲、窗口大小、Spectre 的玩具机器。
desc.en: A branch takes a dozen cycles to resolve, and a CPU does not wait: it guesses, gains when right and starts over when wrong. How does it guess so well? Why can one CPU have hundreds of instructions in flight? And why does the guessing leak secrets? Ten models: 1-bit and 2-bit counters, the sorted array, gshare, TAGE, the return stack, superscalar issue, renaming and the reorder buffer, window size, and a toy machine for Spectre.

title.zh: 多个核心怎么共用一块内存
title.en: How Cores Share Memory

desc.zh: 八个核心各有自己的缓存，却要看到同一块内存。一个核心改了一个数，别的核心怎么知道？为什么两个线程各加一百万次，结果却不是两百万？为什么有的 CPU 上程序对，换一种 CPU 就错？九个可以动手的模型：缓存一致性的两条规矩，MSI、MESI 与 MOESI 的窥探模拟器，目录协议，丢失的更新，CAS 与原子加法，核心之间搬一行要多久，顺序一致性、x86-TSO 与弱内存模型的石蕊测试，以及四种自旋锁的扩展性。
desc.en: Eight cores each have their own caches, yet must see one memory. When one core changes a number, how do the others find out? Why do two threads that each add one a million times not end at two million? Why does a program that runs correctly on one CPU fail on another? Nine hands-on models: the two rules of cache coherence, a snooping simulator for MSI, MESI and MOESI, directory protocols, the lost update, CAS and fetch-and-add, how long a line takes to move between cores, litmus tests under sequential consistency, x86-TSO and a weak memory model, and how four spinlocks scale.

title.zh: CPU 是怎么算小数的，又怎么一次算一排
title.en: How a CPU Does Math: Real Numbers, and Many at Once

desc.zh: 一块 CPU 每秒做几千亿次小数运算，却连 0.1 都存不准。这篇从 32 个位讲起：浮点数的位怎么排，ulp，舍入，次正规数，抵消，FMA，AI 带进硬件的 FP16、BF16、FP8 和块缩放格式，再到 SIMD、AVX-512、SVE 和矩阵单元。十几个可以动手的模型，数都是逐位算出来的。
desc.en: A CPU does hundreds of billions of arithmetic operations on fractions every second, yet it cannot even store 0.1 exactly. This essay starts from 32 bits: how the bits of a floating-point number are laid out, ulps, rounding, subnormals, cancellation, FMA, the FP16, BF16, FP8 and block-scaled formats AI brought into hardware, and then SIMD, AVX-512, SVE and matrix units. A dozen hands-on models, every number computed bit by bit.

title.zh: 内存是怎么和 CPU 说话的
title.en: How Memory Talks to the CPU

desc.zh: 内存条上写着 DDR5-6400、CL32，频率越高延迟数字反而越大，它到底快了没有？CPU 要一个字节，内存条里发生了哪些事？为什么内存条这么多年还在用一大排并行的线？十个模型：刷新占掉多少时间、一个地址落进哪一行、一个按周期走的 DRAM 命令模拟器、CL 的周期与纳秒、带宽与行命中、bank 组、飞越式布线与训练、片上 ECC 与旁路 ECC、PAM3、行锤与防护。
desc.en: A DDR5-6400 CL32 module has a bigger latency number than DDR4: is it faster? What happens inside the module when the CPU asks for one byte? Why does memory still use a wide set of parallel wires? Ten models: how much time refresh takes, which row an address lands in, a cycle-by-cycle DRAM command simulator, CL in cycles and nanoseconds, bandwidth against row hits, bank groups, fly-by routing and training, on-die and side-band ECC, PAM3, and row hammer with its defences.

title.zh: 芯片之间怎么共用内存
title.en: How Chips Share Memory

desc.zh: 一台服务器里的 CPU、GPU、加速卡和内存扩展卡各有各的内存，为什么现在都想共用一块？靠一根 PCIe 线怎么做到缓存一致？几十上百块 GPU 又怎么连成一台机器？九个可以动手的模型：复制还是共享、CXL 数据帧的槽位账、三类设备的消息、内存扩展与冷热分层、内存池、背向作废、一步步走的环形全归约、全归约要多久、纵向与横向扩展；另有 NVLink 对照表和封装里的一致性。
desc.en: A server's CPU, GPUs, accelerators and memory-expansion cards each have their own memory. Why do they all want to share one, how is a cache kept coherent across a PCIe wire, and how are dozens of GPUs joined into one machine? Nine hands-on models: copy or share, the slot accounting of CXL flits, the messages of the three device types, memory expansion and hot/cold tiering, memory pooling, back-invalidate, ring all-reduce step by step, how long an all-reduce takes, and scale-up versus scale-out; plus an NVLink table and coherence inside one package.

title.zh: GPU 是怎么算的
title.en: How a GPU Computes

desc.zh: 一块 GPU 有上万个「核」，每个都比 CPU 的核笨得多。它是怎么把一张图、一次矩阵乘法拆给这么多笨核同时做的？为什么同一段代码，写法稍微一变，GPU 上能慢好几倍？十个可以动手的模型：缓存和多线程两种藏延迟的办法，把一张图映射到网格、线程块和线程束，线程束调度器逐拍模拟，H100 一个 SM 能养多少线程束，分支发散，合并访存，共享内存的 bank 冲突，分块矩阵乘法的两级屋顶，各种数字格式下张量核心的峰值，以及把三角形光栅化成 2×2 像素组。
desc.en: A GPU has tens of thousands of "cores", each far simpler than a CPU core. How does it split an image or a matrix multiply across so many of them at once? Why can the same code run several times slower on a GPU after a small change in how it is written? Ten hands-on models: caches versus more threads as two ways to hide latency, mapping an image onto a grid of blocks and warps, a cycle-by-cycle warp scheduler, how many warps one H100 SM can hold, branch divergence, memory coalescing, shared-memory bank conflicts, two roofs for a tiled matrix multiply, tensor-core peaks across number formats, and rasterising a triangle into 2×2 pixel quads.

title.zh: 电脑是怎么开机的
title.en: How a Computer Boots

desc.zh: 按下电源键到看到登录界面，大约十几秒。一颗刚上电、什么都不知道的 CPU，是怎么找到第一条指令、找到内存、找到硬盘、把操作系统请进来的？它又怎么确认请进来的不是恶意代码？十个可以动手的模型：ATX 电源的上电时序，复位向量的地址，SPI 闪存读一行要多久，开机每一段花多少时间，ACPI 表的校验和，GUID 分区表与 CRC32，安全启动的签名链，撤销一个签过名的引导程序要付什么代价，TPM 的 PCR 扩展，以及叫醒其余核心的时间。
desc.en: About a dozen seconds pass between pressing the power button and the login screen. How does a CPU that knows nothing find its first instruction, its memory, its disk and the operating system, and how does it make sure what it loads is not malicious? Ten hands-on models: ATX power-on timing, the reset-vector address, how long an SPI flash read takes, where boot time goes, an ACPI table checksum, the GUID partition table with CRC32, the Secure Boot signature chain, the cost of revoking a signed boot loader, TPM PCR extends, and how long it takes to wake the other cores.

title.zh: 操作系统是怎么和硬件说话的
title.en: How the OS Talks to Hardware

desc.zh: 程序里写一句 read()，几微秒后数据就从硬盘或网卡那里来了，可用户程序碰不到任何硬件。这句话怎么穿过那堵墙，找到对的驱动和设备，再把结果送回来？九个可以动手的模型：一条指令在哪个特权级会被拦下，系统调用的寄存器约定，一次进出内核要多少周期，读设备寄存器为什么贵，中断、轮询和 NAPI 各花多少 CPU，描述符环多大才不丢包，驱动怎么和设备配对，一次 read() 在每一层花多久，以及 epoll 和 io_uring 每次 I/O 要几次系统调用。
desc.en: A read() in your program brings data back from a disk or a network card within microseconds, yet a user program cannot touch any hardware. How does that one line cross the wall, find the right driver and device, and bring the result back? Nine hands-on models: which instruction traps at which privilege level, the system-call register convention, the cycles of one kernel crossing, why reading a device register is expensive, the CPU cost of interrupts, polling and NAPI, how large a descriptor ring must be not to drop packets, how drivers bind to devices, where one read() spends its time layer by layer, and how many system calls epoll and io_uring make per I/O.

title.zh: 像素是怎么到屏幕上的
title.en: How Pixels Reach a Screen

desc.zh: 一块 4K 屏每秒刷新 120 次，就是每秒要送出近十亿个像素，每个都得在对的时刻亮成对的颜色。它们怎么从显卡的一块内存，经过一根线，变成眼前的光？画面为什么会撕裂、卡顿？十一个可以动手的模型：一帧有多少字节，按真实时序表算像素时钟，撕裂与垂直同步的时间线，可变刷新率与低帧率补偿，颜色管线与查找表，一根线放不放得下一种画面，4:2:0 抽掉了什么，一行像素有多少时间充电，眼睛跟着看时的运动模糊，HDR 的 PQ 曲线，以及从点鼠标到屏幕变亮的延迟。
desc.en: A 4K screen refreshing 120 times a second has to deliver nearly a billion pixels a second, each lit the right colour at the right moment. How do they get from a block of GPU memory, through one cable, to light in front of your eyes, and why does the picture tear or stutter? Eleven hands-on models: how many bytes a frame takes, the pixel clock from real timing tables, a tearing and vsync timeline, variable refresh with low framerate compensation, the colour pipeline and its lookup tables, whether a cable fits a given mode, what 4:2:0 throws away, how long a row of pixels has to charge, motion blur when the eye tracks, the HDR PQ curve, and the latency from mouse click to light.

title.zh: 电是怎么送进 CPU 的
title.en: How Power Reaches the CPU

desc.zh: 一颗 CPU 只用一伏左右的电压，却能吃下两三百瓦，也就是两百安上下的电流，负载还会在十来纳秒里猛跳上百安。电是怎么从墙上的插座一路送进芯片的？芯片为什么会自己降频？八个可以动手的模型：从插座到晶粒每一段丢掉多少电，功率怎么随电压和频率涨，电源在什么负载下最省，多相稳压怎么把纹波抵掉，负载一跳电压往下掉多少，跑完一件事用多快的频率最省电，空闲时睡多深，以及功率墙和散热器怎么一起决定频率。
desc.en: A CPU runs on about one volt, yet it can draw 200 to 300 watts, roughly 200 amps, and its load can jump by a hundred amps in about ten nanoseconds. How does power get from the wall socket into the chip, and why does the chip slow itself down? Eight hands-on models: how much each stage from the wall to the die loses, how power grows with voltage and frequency, at what load a power supply is most efficient, how a multiphase regulator cancels its ripple, how far the voltage sags when the load jumps, which clock finishes a job on the least energy, how deep to sleep when idle, and how power limits and the cooler together set the clock.

title.zh: 网卡是怎么搬运数据包的
title.en: How a Network Card Moves Packets

desc.zh: 一张 400G 网卡，每秒要收三千多万个包，平均每个包只有三十纳秒，比一次内存访问还短。它怎么在 CPU 几乎不插手的情况下，把包从光纤里搬进正确的那个程序的内存？十个可以动手的模型：一帧以太网和它的校验码，线速下每个包的时间，描述符为什么要提前取，PCIe 装不装得下 400G，RSS 的托普利茨哈希，几条大流怎么把队列压歪，分段和接收卸载省多少 CPU，DDIO 的缓存为什么会漏，发送环里排多少字节才合适，内核协议栈、XDP 和 DPDK 各要几个核，以及训练集群里 ECMP 和包喷洒的差别。
desc.en: A 400G network card receives more than thirty million packets a second, about thirty nanoseconds each, less than one memory access. How does it move them from the fibre into the memory of the right program with the CPU hardly involved? Ten hands-on models: one Ethernet frame and its check sequence, the time per packet at line rate, why descriptors are fetched ahead, whether PCIe can carry 400G, the Toeplitz hash behind RSS, how a few big flows skew the queues, how much CPU segmentation and receive offloads save, why DDIO leaks, how many bytes belong in the transmit ring, how many cores the kernel stack, XDP and DPDK need, and ECMP versus packet spraying in a training cluster.

title.zh: 经济是怎样被计量的
title.en: How an Economy Is Measured

desc.zh: 一个经济体“好不好”，到底是怎么量出来的？从 GDP 三面等价、物价指数与 CPI、增长率陷阱、PPP 与基尼系数、劳动力市场、周期与萨姆规则、索洛分解，到 GDP 边界与 2025 SNA 前沿。
desc.en: How do we measure how well an economy is doing? From the three-sided GDP identity, price indexes and CPI, growth-rate traps, PPP and Gini, labour markets, business cycles and the Sahm rule, and Solow growth accounting to GDP boundaries and the 2025 SNA frontier.

title.zh: 傅里叶变换 · 一步一交互
title.en: The Fourier Transform · One Interaction at a Time

desc.zh: 任何波形、任何图形，都能拆成一堆旋转的圆。从一条正弦波开始，七步亲手拼出傅里叶变换，最后画任意图形让圆圈重画出来。
desc.en: Any waveform — any picture — can be taken apart into rotating circles. Start from a single sine wave, build the Fourier transform with your own hands in seven steps, then draw any shape and watch the circles redraw it.

title.zh: 卷积 · 一步一交互
title.en: Convolution · One Interaction at a Time

desc.zh: 把一张照片变糊、把声音加上回声、把抖动的数据变平滑，背后是同一台机器：卷积。七步亲手滑动、翻卷、相乘、求和，最后看它在频域里和傅里叶相遇。
desc.en: Blurring a photo, adding echo to a sound, smoothing jittery data — behind all of them sits the same machine: convolution. Slide, flip, multiply and sum your way through seven steps, then watch it meet the Fourier transform in the frequency domain.

title.zh: Mandelbrot 分形 · 无限放大
title.en: The Mandelbrot Set · Zoom Without End

desc.zh: 一行幼儿园算术 z→z²+c，反复按下去，能长出无限复杂的图形。拖动放大一千亿倍细节还在生长，每个点背后还藏着一整张朱利亚集。
desc.en: One line of schoolchild arithmetic, z → z² + c, pressed over and over, grows a picture of endless complexity. Drag to zoom a hundred billion times and the detail is still growing — and behind every point hides an entire Julia set.

title.zh: 反馈与控制 · 双轮车为什么倒不下去
title.en: Feedback & Control · Why the Two-Wheeled Bot Never Falls

desc.zh: 一辆双轮车天生站不住，让它站住的不是更强的电机，而是一个转得够快的圈。亲手当一回控制器、亲手调坏再调好一套 PID，再让延迟、噪声和饱和逐个来拆台。
desc.en: A two-wheeled balancing bot is born unable to stand. What keeps it up is not a stronger motor but a loop that spins fast enough. Take the controller's seat yourself, tune a PID badly then well, and let delay, noise and saturation each try to wreck it.

title.zh: 采样与混叠 · 偷看得太懒，就会看错
title.en: Sampling & Aliasing · Peek Too Lazily and You'll See It Wrong

desc.zh: 车轮在视频里为什么会倒转？采样就是每隔一会儿偷看世界一眼——看得太懒，眼睛会连出一波根本不存在的假信号。奈奎斯特的那条线、44.1 kHz 的由来，都在这里亲手玩明白。
desc.en: Why do wheels spin backwards on video? Sampling is peeking at the world every so often — peek too lazily and your eyes will invent a signal that was never there. Play with the Nyquist line and the origin of 44.1 kHz until they click.

title.zh: 三角函数 · 单位圆
title.en: Trigonometric Functions · The Unit Circle

desc.zh: sin 是身高、cos 是站位、tan 是斜率——三个函数是同一个圆的三个投影。拖着点绕一圈，看正弦波从圆的侧影里长出来；这一页是傅里叶变换的前传。
desc.en: Sine is a height, cosine a position, tangent a slope — three functions that are three projections of one circle. Drag the point around and watch the sine wave grow out of the circle's silhouette; this page is the prequel to the Fourier transform.

title.zh: 蒙特卡洛 · 撒豆子算 π
title.en: Monte Carlo · Counting π with Scattered Beans

desc.zh: 算不出来的问题，可以撒豆子撒出来：随机撒点落在圆内的比例就是面积比，π 自己浮出来。误差按 1/√N 收缩——想多准一位，点要多撒一百倍。
desc.en: Some problems you can't solve, you can scatter your way to: the fraction of random points landing in a circle is an area ratio, and π surfaces on its own. Error shrinks like 1/√N — one more digit costs a hundred times the points.

title.zh: 拉普拉斯与 ROC · 给频率配一个寿命
title.en: Laplace Transform & ROC · Giving Frequencies a Lifespan

desc.zh: 傅里叶假设每个音永远在响；拉普拉斯多问一句：它在衰减还是在增长？s 平面上的地形、极点与收敛域——同一页里装下傅里叶的切片和控制的战场。
desc.en: Fourier assumes every tone rings forever; Laplace also asks whether it is dying or exploding. Terrain, poles and regions of convergence on the s-plane — one map holding both the Fourier slice and the control battlefield.

title.zh: 贝叶斯 · 先查底子，再看证据
title.en: Bayes · Check the Base Rate Before the Evidence

desc.zh: 检测说你阳性，你真中招的概率只有 9%——检测没骗你，是底子太薄。先验、似然比、证据连乘：信念更新其实是一本流水账。
desc.en: The test says positive, yet your chance of actually having it is 9% — the test didn't lie; the base rate is thin. Priors, likelihood ratios and chained evidence: belief updating as a running ledger.

title.zh: 中心极限定理 · 平均值总会变成钟形
title.en: Central Limit Theorem · Averages Always Turn Bell-Shaped

desc.zh: 单颗骰子毫无钟形可言，平均起来钟形却拔地而起。不管原料长什么样，均值的分布总是正态——只要方差有限：精度按 σ/√n 定价，民调的 ±3% 也从这里来。
desc.en: A single die has nothing bell-shaped about it, yet average enough dice and the bell rises. Whatever the raw material looks like, means turn normal — as long as the variance is finite. Precision is priced at σ/√n, and polling's ±3% is born here too.

title.zh: Z 变换 · 把 s 平面卷成单位圆
title.en: The Z-Transform · Rolling the s-Plane into the Unit Circle

desc.zh: 离散世界没有连续时间，它的拉普拉斯住在一个圆里：z = e^{sT} 把左半平面卷进单位圆内、虚轴卷成圆周。极点在圆内活、圆上鸣、圆外炸。
desc.en: The discrete world has no continuous time; its Laplace lives on a circle. z = e^{sT} rolls the left half-plane inside the unit circle and the axis onto its rim — poles live inside, sing on it, and explode outside.

title.zh: 梯度下降 · 摸黑下山
title.en: Gradient Descent · Feeling Your Way Downhill

desc.zh: 训练模型，就是在看不见的地形上摸黑下山：坡度是唯一的信息，步子迈多大决定你走到谷底、原地打转还是飞出去。所有神经网络的训练，剥到底就是这一页的循环。
desc.en: Training a model is feeling your way down a landscape you cannot see: the slope is your only information, and your step size decides whether you reach the bottom, spin in place, or fly off. All of neural-network training, stripped down, is this page's loop.

title.zh: 特征值与特征向量 · 矩阵不转的那些方向
title.en: Eigenvalues & Eigenvectors · The Directions a Matrix Cannot Turn

desc.zh: 矩阵把空间里的箭头普遍转走，只有少数方向例外：只被拉长、缩短或翻转。从捏圆的机器一路到 PCA 与谷歌的 PageRank，中间只隔一个问题：哪个方向不会被转走？
desc.en: A matrix turns almost every arrow in space — except a few directions it can only stretch, shrink, or flip. From a circle squeezed into an ellipse to PCA and Google's PageRank, it all comes down to one question: which directions refuse to turn?

title.zh: 熵 · 惊讶的平均值
title.en: Entropy · The Average of Surprise

desc.zh: 越意外的事，信息量越大；熵把一个随机源的整体不确定性压成一个数。它既是压缩的绝对极限，也是机器学习损失函数的老祖宗，还与热力学的熵同源同式。
desc.en: The more surprising an event, the more information it carries; entropy compresses a source's total uncertainty into a single number. It is the absolute limit of compression, the ancestor of ML loss functions, and kin to the entropy of thermodynamics.

title.zh: 冲激与 LTI · 给系统一巴掌
title.en: Impulse & LTI · Slap the System

desc.zh: 想认识一个系统，别逐个试输入——扇它一巴掌，把它对冲激的全部回答 h 录下来。只要它是线性时不变的，这份指纹就决定了它对一切输入的回答；公理垮掉的地方，魔法当场失效给你看。
desc.en: To know a system, don't test input after input — slap it once and record its full answer to an impulse. If it is linear and time-invariant, that fingerprint h decides its answer to everything; where the axioms break, watch the magic fail on the spot.

title.zh: 频率响应与滤波 · 按频率挑食的盒子
title.en: Frequency Response & Filters · A Box That Eats by Frequency

desc.zh: LTI 系统对正弦只做两件事：按 |H(ω)| 缩放、按 φ(ω) 迟到。把这两条曲线量出来，你就既会读波特图，也会按指标亲手设计一个滤波器——零点、相位、带通、验收，全是真算。
desc.en: An LTI system does only two things to a sine: scale it by |H(ω)| and delay it by φ(ω). Measure those two curves and you can both read a Bode plot and design a filter to spec — zeros, phase, bandpass, and a bench verdict, all computed for real.

title.zh: 调制与频移 · 把信号搬上高频运走
title.en: Modulation · Shipping Signals on a Carrier

desc.zh: 声音跑不远也挤不下——乘一个载波，频谱整体搬家。AM 搬幅度的形状、FM 搬频率的摆动；解调要对准频率与相位，串扰、过调制、抗噪差距，全由真采样与 FFT 现算给你看。
desc.en: Voices can't travel far or share one band — multiply by a carrier and the whole spectrum moves house. AM ships the shape of the amplitude, FM the wobble of frequency; demodulation, crosstalk, overmodulation, and the noise gap, all computed live from real samples and FFTs.

title.zh: 卡尔曼滤波 · 在预测与测量之间称重
title.en: Kalman Filter · Weighing Prediction Against Measurement

desc.zh: 真实状态永远看不见：模型预测一份、带噪测量一份，卡尔曼按各自的不确定度当场算出该信谁几成。增益 K 如何自己定下来、如何从位置估出没测过的速度——全是递推真算。
desc.en: The true state is never visible: a model predicts, a noisy sensor measures, and the Kalman filter weighs the two by their uncertainties, live. How gain K settles itself, and how velocity gets estimated from position alone — every step from the real recursion.

title.zh: 排序与大 O · 增长的形状
title.en: Sorting & Big O · The Shape of Growth

desc.zh: 算法之间的差别不在能不能排，在比较次数如何随数据量增长。冒泡、选择、归并、快排、计数排序的每个计数都由真实代码当场数出——连大 O 的形状，都是从实测表里拟合出来的。
desc.en: Algorithms differ not in whether they sort, but in how their comparison counts grow with n. Bubble, selection, merge, quick and counting sort — every count produced live by real code, and the Big O shapes fitted from the measured table itself.

title.zh: 分数 · 把整体切开来数
title.en: Fractions · Cutting the Whole to Count

desc.zh: 分数不是两个数上下摆，是一个数：先看 1/2 与 2/4 叠合得严丝合缝，再到等值、比大小、加法先通分、假分数长过一条——运算全部用精确有理数，循环小数老老实实写 ≈。本站第一个小学学段页面。
desc.en: A fraction is one number, not two stacked: watch 1/2 and 2/4 overlap pixel-perfectly, then equivalence, comparison, common denominators, and improper fractions longer than one bar — all arithmetic exact, repeating decimals honestly marked ≈. The site's first primary-school page.

title.zh: 勾股定理 · 一步一交互
title.en: The Pythagorean Theorem · One Interaction at a Time

desc.zh: a²+b²=c² 不是背出来的：3-4-5 先露馅，再用面积灌注和拼图把等式拼出来，拖着顶点怎么拖都等，最后反过来判角、算梯子，并撞见怎么也写不尽的 √2。
desc.en: a²+b²=c², earned rather than memorised: the 3-4-5 coincidence first, then area pouring and a jigsaw proof, dragging the vertex without breaking equality, classifying angles in reverse, a ladder problem, and finally √2 — the length no fraction can write.

title.zh: 乘法是面积 · 点阵铺成一块地
title.en: Multiplication Is Area · Arrays Become a Tiled Floor

desc.zh: 先不背口诀，把乘法看成面积：点阵铺成地砖、转个方向读出交换律；一块地切一刀，13×17 自己拆成四块相加——这就是分配律和竖式的来历；最后拿 24 块砖反着拼，反找因数对。
desc.en: Multiplication as area before memorised tables: dot arrays become tiled floors, a quarter-turn shows commutativity, and one cut through a plot splits 13×17 into four blocks that add back up — where the distributive law and the written algorithm come from; ends by factoring 24 tiles in reverse.

title.zh: 周长 vs 面积 · 一根绳子两种账
title.en: Perimeter vs Area · One Rope, Two Ledgers

desc.zh: 一根 24 米的绳子围地：绳子账（周长）怎么围都不变，地砖账（面积）却从 11 一路变到 36——越接近正方形越大；再反过来，面积固定时细长形状最费绳子。两个最容易混的量，这次分得清清楚楚。
desc.en: Fence a plot with one 24-metre rope: the rope ledger (perimeter) never changes, but the tile ledger (area) runs from 11 all the way to 36 — the closer to a square, the bigger; then in reverse, fixed area costs the most rope when long and thin. Two quantities everyone mixes up, finally kept apart.

title.zh: 除法与余数 · 分不完的那一点
title.en: Division & Remainders · What Is Left Over

desc.zh: 分糖果分到最后总剩几颗：先动手一份一份发，再到数轴上一格一格跳——余数为什么必须比除数小，跳着跳着就明白了；然后是验算恒等式和星期几的循环，最后两道自测题收口。
desc.en: Sharing sweets until a few are left over: deal them out one share at a time, then hop along the number line — and see for yourself why the remainder must stay smaller than the divisor; then the check identity, weekday cycles, and a two-question self-test.

title.zh: 一次函数 · 斜率是陡缓，截距是起点
title.en: Linear Functions · Slope Is Steepness, Intercept Is the Start

desc.zh: y=kx+b 不背公式，先拖出来：落点一格一格等高抬升、连成直线，k 就是坡的陡缓；整条线上下平移，b 就是还没出发就站的高度；最后两条线相遇，交点同时满足两个方程——平行和重合两种特例也亲手摆得出来。
desc.en: y = kx + b, earned by dragging instead of rote: points rising by equal steps line up straight — k is the steepness; slide the whole line up or down and b is the height you start from before moving; and when two lines meet, their crossing point satisfies both equations at once, with parallel and coincident cases reachable by hand.

title.zh: 对称与旋转 · 对折与转圈
title.en: Symmetry & Rotation · Folding and Turning

desc.zh: 沿一条线对折、两边严丝合缝，那条线就是对称轴；转过一个角度又变回自己，那是旋转对称。正方形有 4 条轴，平行四边形一条都没有、却转半圈就重合——最后开一台万花筒，只画一小块，图案自己长满。
desc.en: Fold along a line and the two halves match exactly — that line is an axis of symmetry; turn through the right angle and the shape is itself again — rotational symmetry. A square has 4 axes; a parallelogram has none, yet matches itself after half a turn. At the end, a kaleidoscope grows a full pattern from one small wedge you draw.

title.zh: 抛物线 · 投篮的弧线
title.en: Parabolas · The Arc of a Shot

desc.zh: 投篮的弧线就是抛物线：a 管开口方向与胖瘦；写成顶点式，顶点和对称轴直接写在式子的脸上，随着滑杆搬家；球最后落在哪里，就是图与 x 轴的交点——两个、一个，还是一个都没有，拖一拖全摆得出来。
desc.en: A basketball's arc is a parabola: a sets the opening direction and width; written in vertex form, the curve wears its vertex and axis of symmetry on its face and moves house as you drag; and where the ball lands is exactly where the curve meets the x-axis — two crossings, one touch, or none at all, every case reachable by hand.

title.zh: 速度与 v-t 图 · 面积就是路
title.en: Speed and the v–t Graph · Area Is Distance

desc.zh: 先看一场赛跑：位置—时间图像的陡缓就是快慢；换上速度—时间图像，看的是高低、不是陡缓；图像下方的面积，数出来正是走过的路——把加速段切成 4 条、8 条、16 条窄条，台阶和会一步步贴近真路程。
desc.en: Start with a race: on a position–time graph, steepness is speed. Switch to a velocity–time graph and you read height, not steepness — and the area under the graph counts out exactly the distance travelled. Slice the speeding-up stretch into 4, 8, 16 thin strips and watch the step sums close in on the true distance.

title.zh: 定积分 · 把小条加回整体
title.en: The Definite Integral · Adding the Strips Back Up

desc.zh: 曲边围成的面积没有公式可套——那就切：把曲线下切成 1、2、4…32 条长方形，左和与右和从两边夹住真值，缝越切越窄；条无限细时两边贴到的那个数就是定积分。而求它有捷径：找到导数是它自己的那个函数，积分与导数就此接头。
desc.en: No formula fits an area under a curve — so slice it: cut the region into 1, 2, 4 … 32 rectangles, let the left and right sums squeeze the true value from both sides, and watch the gap narrow. The number both sides close in on is the definite integral — and there is a shortcut: find the function whose derivative it is, and integration shakes hands with differentiation.

title.zh: 光的反射与折射 · 拐弯的规矩
title.en: Reflection & Refraction · How Light Bends

desc.zh: 光撞上界面会拐弯，拐多少有规矩：反射角等于入射角、而且都从法线量起；进了水会偏向法线；从水里往外射、角度太陡还会全部反射回去；连鱼在水里的位置都是假的——眼睛看到的虚像比真身浅。
desc.en: Light bends at a boundary, and the bending follows rules: the angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence, and both are measured from the normal; entering water it bends toward the normal; leaving water too steeply, it reflects entirely back. Even a fish is not where it looks — the virtual image your eye sees sits shallower than the fish itself.

title.zh: 导数 · 把平均压成此刻
title.en: The Derivative · Squeezing the Average into the Instant

desc.zh: 平均速度谁都会算，可「这一刻」有多快？把区间一点点缩向那一刻：割线从左右两侧靠拢成切线，斜率收敛到的那个数，就是导数。沿着曲线每一点都量一遍，导数们自己又排成一条新曲线——导函数出场。
desc.en: Anyone can compute an average speed — but how fast is it right now? Shrink the interval toward the instant: the secant line closes in from both sides into the tangent, and the number its slope settles on is the derivative. Measure it at every point along the curve and the derivatives line up into a new curve of their own — the derivative function.

title.zh: 凸透镜成像 · 远近变像
title.en: The Convex Lens · Near or Far, the Image Transforms

desc.zh: 蜡烛离凸透镜的远近一变，像的大小、正倒、实虚全跟着变：越过二倍焦距，像由大变小；越过一倍焦距，像从光屏上跳进眼睛里——实像能被屏接住，虚像接不住、只能看。三条特殊光线，就能把像画出来。
desc.en: Slide a candle toward a convex lens and everything about its image changes — size, orientation, real or virtual. Cross twice the focal length and the image starts shrinking; cross one focal length and it leaps off the screen into your eye: a real image can be caught on a screen, a virtual one can only be seen. Three special rays are all it takes to draw exactly where the image lands.

title.zh: 波的干涉 · 闹与静的图样
title.en: Interference · A Pattern of Loud and Still

desc.zh: 两列波相遇，每一点的振动就是两者相加：步调一致的地方更闹，步调相反的地方反而安静——而且静点永远静、响点永远响。决定加强还是抵消的，是到两个波源的路程差：整数倍波长加强，半整数倍抵消，图样由几何定死。
desc.en: When two waves meet, every point's motion is the sum of both: where they arrive in step, the motion doubles; where they arrive out of step, it cancels — and the still points stay still forever. The decider is the path difference to the two sources: whole wavelengths reinforce, half wavelengths cancel, and the pattern is fixed by geometry.

title.zh: 指数与对数 · 翻倍与逆问
title.en: Exponentials & Logarithms · Doubling and the Reverse Question

desc.zh: 每小时翻一倍，24 小时就是一千六百多万——指数增长为什么这么猛？反过来问「2 的几次方等于 6」，那个答案就是对数：它不是没算完的小数，而是一个准确的名字。在对数尺上，乘法会变成加法——这就是对数尺的本事。
desc.en: Doubling every hour gives over sixteen million in a day — why is exponential growth so fierce? Ask the question backwards — 2 to what power makes 6? — and the answer is a logarithm: not an unfinished decimal, but an exact name for the exponent. And on a log scale, multiplication turns into addition.

title.zh: 圆周角 · 为什么恰好是一半
title.en: Inscribed Angles · Why Exactly Half

desc.zh: 圆上一点看一条弧，张角永远是圆心看它的恰好一半——拖着点满圆跑都变不了。连一条半径，两个等腰三角形把这一半算得明明白白；弧过半圈，张角正好是直角。
desc.en: From any point on the circle, an arc subtends exactly half the angle it subtends at the centre — drag the point all the way round and it never changes. One extra radius splits the proof into two isosceles triangles; and once the arc passes a semicircle, the angle is exactly a right angle.

title.zh: 复数 · 平面上的旋转
title.en: Complex Numbers · Rotation on the Plane

desc.zh: 复数不是硬凑出来的数：a+bi 就是平面上的一个点。乘以 i，是把这个点逆时针转 90°；一般的乘法是模相乘、角相加。代数算一遍、几何看一遍，两条路永远同一个答案。
desc.en: A complex number is not an invented patch: a+bi is a point on the plane. Multiplying by i rotates that point 90° counterclockwise; multiplication in general multiplies the moduli and adds the angles. Compute it algebraically, watch it geometrically — both roads always land on the same answer.

title.zh: 驻波 · 原地起伏的波
title.en: Standing Waves · The Wave That Stays in Place

desc.zh: 两列相同的波迎面相遇，波形不再前进，只在原地起伏：有些点永远不动（波节），有些点振幅翻倍（波腹）。两端固定的弦只放行 L=nλ/2 的台阶，驱动频率踩中台阶，就会共振。
desc.en: Two identical waves travelling towards each other lock into a pattern that no longer travels — it only rises and falls in place: some points never move (nodes), others swing with double amplitude (antinodes). A string fixed at both ends admits only L = nλ/2, and driving it on one of those steps is resonance.

title.zh: 负数 · 0 以下的世界
title.en: Negative Numbers · The World Below Zero

desc.zh: 温度计掉到 0 以下、电梯下到 B1——负数记的是「在基准的另一边、还差多少」。放上数轴一比就懂：越往左越小，所以 −3 比 −7 暖和。这一页只讲现象和比较，不背法则。
desc.en: Thermometers drop below zero and lifts go down to B1 — negative numbers record 'on the other side of the reference point, and by how much'. Put them on a number line and it clicks: further left means smaller, so −3 is warmer than −7. This page is phenomena and comparison only — no rules to memorise.

title.zh: 小孔成像 · 一个孔的相机
title.en: Pinhole Camera · A Camera With One Tiny Hole

desc.zh: 没有镜头，只有一个小孔，屏幕上却出现一幅倒过来的画：光沿直线走，物上每一点的光只能穿过小孔落到屏上一个地方。像高由物距、像距的比定死，孔大了画会糊成一片光斑。
desc.en: No lens, just a tiny hole — yet an upside-down picture appears on the screen: light travels straight, so light from each point of the object can pass the hole and land in exactly one place. Image height is fixed by the ratio of the two distances, and a bigger hole blurs the picture into a patch of light.

title.zh: 空间对角线 · 3D 里的两次勾股
title.en: The Space Diagonal · Pythagoras Twice, in 3D

desc.zh: 长方体里最长的那条斜线有多长？把立体压回平面算两次：先在底面用勾股算出对角线，再拿它当一条直角边、竖起高来第二次勾股。拖动 3D 长方体转着看，两次勾股都写在真实的棱上。
desc.en: How long is the longest line inside a box? Flatten the solid back into planes and apply Pythagoras twice: first across the base, then using that diagonal as one leg of a vertical right triangle. Orbit the 3D cuboid and watch both applications drawn on the real edges.

title.zh: 坐标系 · 点的地址
title.en: The Coordinate Plane · Addresses for Points

desc.zh: 给平面定一个原点、两条轴，每个点就有了一个地址 (x, y)。换原点，点没动、地址全变；横纵一换位，点沿对角线翻到对面。这套地址系统，是所有函数图像的地基。
desc.en: Fix an origin and two axes, and every point on the plane gets an address (x, y). Move the origin and the points stay exactly where they are while every address shifts; swap the two coordinates and the point flips across the diagonal. This address system is the groundwork under every function graph.

title.zh: 粒子与物态 · 热闹程度即温度
title.en: Particles & States · Temperature Is How Wildly They Move

desc.zh: 把物质放大到一颗颗粒子：挤在一起原地抖的是固体，松开能流动的是液体，满屋乱飞的是气体。加热就是让粒子动得更野——温度不是另一样东西，它就是粒子平均动得有多快。升温到熔点、沸点还会各卡一段平台。
desc.en: Zoom into matter as individual particles: packed and jiggling in place is a solid, loosened and flowing is a liquid, flying everywhere is a gas. Heating just makes the particles move more wildly — temperature is not a separate thing, it is how fast they move on average. And at the melting and boiling points, the temperature stalls on a plateau.

title.zh: 原子结构 · 质子数定它是谁
title.en: Atomic Structure · The Proton Count Decides What It Is

desc.zh: 原子不是实心球：中间一个极小的核几乎占了全部质量，电子在外面按层排布。质子数定它是谁，最外层电子数定它活泼不活泼——改数字、当场算，全部账都摆在明处。
desc.en: An atom is not a solid ball: a tiny nucleus at the centre holds almost all the mass, and electrons arrange themselves in layers outside it. The proton count decides what it is; the outermost electron count decides how reactive it is — change the numbers and watch everything recompute.

title.zh: 杠杆与滑轮 · 支点挪一挪，省力见分晓
title.en: Levers & Pulleys · Move the Fulcrum, Feel the Trade

desc.zh: 小力凭什么撬动大物？这一页算两本账。转动的账看力矩：力 × 力臂，两边相等就平衡——支点挪一挪，同样的重物要用的力立刻变。可省力从不是白省：功的账本两边永远相等，省几倍力就费几倍距离。到了滑轮组更干脆，不用算，数一数吊着重物的绳子段数，就知道省几倍力。全页 g 取 10 N/kg，力一律用牛顿（N）。
desc.en: How can a small force lift a huge weight? This page keeps two ledgers. The turning ledger is torque: force × lever arm — when both sides match, the lever balances, and sliding the fulcrum changes the force you need at once. But saved force is never free: the work ledger always balances, so every multiple of force saved costs the same multiple of distance. For pulley systems it is even simpler — do not compute, just count the rope segments holding the load. Throughout, g = 10 N/kg and forces are in newtons (N).

title.zh: 方程天平 · 两边同做一件事
title.en: Equations on a Balance · Do the Same to Both Sides

desc.zh: 等号不是「算出答案」的信号，是一架天平的指针：指针归零，两边一样重。这一页我们只学一招——不管做什么，对两边同时做相同的事——用这一招把 x 一个人留在天平左边。
desc.en: The equals sign is not a “compute the answer” button; it is the needle of a balance — at zero, both sides weigh the same. This page teaches one move only: whatever you do, do the same to both sides — and use it to leave x alone on the left.

title.zh: 昼夜交替 · 地球自己在转
title.en: Day and Night · The Earth Itself Is Turning

desc.zh: 不是太阳绕着我们跑：地球绕着自己的轴转，每个地方轮流朝向太阳，于是有了昼夜。转满一圈是一天；站在转动的地面上看，太阳就成了东升西落。
desc.en: The Sun does not circle us: the Earth spins on its own axis and every place takes its turn facing the Sun — that is day and night. One full turn makes a day, and standing on the turning ground, the Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west.

title.zh: 质量守恒 · 原子一个都不丢
title.en: Mass Conservation · Not a Single Atom Lost

desc.zh: 化学反应看起来变重变轻，原子却一个不多、一个不少，只是重新排队。这一页把反应拆开逐个原子数，再用天平对账：敞口跑掉的气体、从空气里加入的氧，都逃不过这本账。
desc.en: Reactions seem to gain or lose weight, yet not a single atom is created or destroyed — they only reshuffle. Take reactions apart and count atoms one by one, then settle it on a balance: escaping gas and oxygen joining from the air both show up in the ledger.

title.zh: 细胞 · 生命的最小单位间
title.en: The Cell · Life's Smallest Workshop

desc.zh: 把一片叶子放大到单个细胞：膜划出边界，核是总控，线粒体供能，叶绿体造糖。点一点每个工位是干什么的，再把动物细胞和植物细胞并排，找齐三处不同。
desc.en: Zoom into a single cell: the membrane draws the boundary, the nucleus runs the place, mitochondria supply energy, chloroplasts make sugar. Tap each workstation to see its job, then put animal and plant cells side by side and find all three differences.

title.zh: 光合作用 · 用光开工的糖厂
title.en: Photosynthesis · A Sugar Factory Run by Light

desc.zh: 叶子用光把水和二氧化碳重排成糖和氧气：方程式逐项点开对原子账；速率随光强和二氧化碳先升后封顶，因为谁最缺谁说了算（限制因素）。
desc.en: A leaf uses light to rearrange water and carbon dioxide into sugar and oxygen: click through the equation and balance the atom ledger; then watch the rate rise with light and CO₂ — and cap out, because the scarcest input rules (the limiting factor).

title.zh: 种群增长 · S 形曲线从哪来
title.en: Population Growth · Where the S-Curve Comes From

desc.zh: 没有天花板时种群按倍数狂奔，有了容纳量 K 就被压成 S 形：每一代的实际增长率由 r(1−N/K) 当场实算；把 r 推过安全区，还能亲眼看到离散模型振荡失效。
desc.en: With no ceiling a population multiplies wildly; with carrying capacity K it bends into an S. The effective rate r(1−N/K) is computed generation by generation — and if you push r past the safe zone, you can watch the discrete model oscillate and break.

title.zh: 化学平衡 · 人数不变，人还在跑
title.en: Chemical Equilibrium · Still Moving at Balance

desc.zh: 平衡不是反应停了，而是正、逆两个方向跑得一样快：计数走平，粒子还在互变。加一把料、升一次温，看平衡点如何移动；再验证催化剂只改快慢、不改终点。
desc.en: Equilibrium is not the reaction stopping — it is both directions running equally fast: counts level off while particles keep swapping. Add material, raise the temperature and watch the balance point shift; then check that a catalyst changes only the speed, never the endpoint.

title.zh: 酸碱平衡 · 分子在两边来回走
title.en: Acid–Base Equilibrium · Molecules Move Both Ways

desc.zh: 从 HA ⇌ H⁺ + A⁻ 的粒子往返出发，拖动 Ka、稀释和共同离子，亲眼看解离比例与 pH 如何一起改写。
desc.en: Start with particles moving through HA ⇌ H⁺ + A⁻, then drag Ka, dilution and a common ion to see dissociation and pH change together.

title.zh: 反应速率 · 数一数成功碰撞
title.en: Reaction Rates · Counting Successful Collisions

desc.zh: 反应快慢取决于成功碰撞的次数：碰得越勤、能量达标的比例越大，反应越快。温度、浓度、表面积、催化剂四种提速办法，全在模拟里数给你看。
desc.en: How fast a reaction runs comes down to successful collisions: collide more often, and get more collisions over the energy bar. Temperature, concentration, surface area and catalysts — all four speed-ups, counted live in the simulation.

title.zh: 贝叶斯诊断 · 阳性结果说明什么？
title.en: Bayes Diagnostics · What Does a Positive Mean?

desc.zh: 把先验、灵敏度、特异度和后验放进 1,000 人频数树，亲眼看见阳性结果的分母如何改变。
desc.en: Tune prevalence, sensitivity and specificity in a 1,000-person frequency tree and see how a positive result changes the denominator.

title.zh: 种群生态学 · 增长如何被反馈改变
title.en: Population Ecology · Growth Reshaped by Feedback

desc.zh: 从内禀增长率 r 和承载力 K 走到捕食者—猎物耦合，拖动参数，追踪资源反馈如何把增长改写成波动。
desc.en: Move from intrinsic rate r and carrying capacity K to predator–prey coupling, then trace how resource feedback reshapes growth into waves.

title.zh: 反馈控制 · 先看差多少，再决定推多少
title.en: Feedback Control · See the Error, Then Act

desc.zh: 从设定值与误差走到 P、I、D：调参时同时看响应、超调、稳态误差和噪声代价。
desc.en: Trace setpoint and error into P, I and D, then tune while watching response, overshoot, steady-state error and noise cost.

title.zh: 阶跃响应 · 阻尼比决定冲多远，固有频率决定多快
title.en: Step Response · Damping Sets the Overshoot, Natural Frequency Sets the Speed

desc.zh: 给二阶系统一个阶跃：拖动阻尼比 ζ 看超调怎样只由它决定，拖动固有频率 ωn 看时间怎样整体伸缩，再在复平面上把两者读成极点。
desc.en: Give a second-order system a step: drag the damping ratio ζ to see overshoot depend on it alone, drag the natural frequency ωn to stretch time, then read both as poles in the complex plane.

title.zh: 遗传与概率 · 从配子到表型
title.en: Genetics & Probability · From Gametes to Phenotypes

desc.zh: 从等位基因分离到 Punnett 方格、独立分配和条件概率，亲手把 3:1 与 9:3:3:1 拆成一条可追踪的因果链。
desc.en: Trace segregation, Punnett squares, independent assortment and conditional probability until 3:1 and 9:3:3:1 become causal, recomputable outcomes.

title.zh: 供需与市场均衡 · 价格线如何相交
title.en: Supply & Demand · Where the Market Clears

desc.zh: 从 Qd = Qs 的交点出发，拖动税、补贴和曲线斜率，追踪楔子、弹性、剩余与无谓损失。
desc.en: Start at Qd = Qs, then tune taxes, subsidies and curve slopes to trace wedges, elasticity, surplus and deadweight loss.

title.zh: 二分查找 · 每次砍掉一半
title.en: Binary Search · Halve the Candidates

desc.zh: 在有序数组里单步追踪 lo、mid、hi：每次比较排除一半候选，再用滑杆看 O(n) 与 O(log n) 的增长差距。
desc.en: Step through lo, mid and hi on a sorted array: each comparison removes half the candidates, then compare O(n) and O(log n) as n grows.

title.zh: 图算法 · 让边带你走
title.en: Graph Algorithms · Let Edges Lead

desc.zh: 在一张可编辑的小图上对比 BFS 队列与 DFS 栈，切换一条边，观察 frontier 和 O(V+E) 如何同步改变。
desc.en: Compare BFS queues and DFS stacks on an editable graph; toggle one edge and watch the frontier and O(V+E) accounting update together.

title.zh: 膜运输 · 梯度如何变成通量
title.en: Membrane Transport · From Gradient to Flux

desc.zh: 拖动内外浓度、通透性和 ATP 泵，追踪梯度如何变成净通量、渗透压和细胞体积变化。
desc.en: Tune inside/outside concentration, permeability and ATP pumping to trace gradients into net flux, osmosis and cell-volume change.

title.zh: 神经动作电位 · 一次脉冲如何跑过神经元
title.en: Action Potentials · How One Pulse Travels

desc.zh: 从静息电位推过阈值，跟着 Na⁺ 内流、K⁺ 外流和不应期走完一次尖峰，再数一秒最多能发几次。
desc.en: Push resting voltage past threshold, follow Na⁺ in, K⁺ out and refractoriness through one spike, then count the maximum spikes per second.

title.zh: 轨道运动 · 椭圆、速度与凌日
title.en: Orbital Motion · Ellipses, Speed & Transits

desc.zh: 把偏心率、轨道相位、速度变化和凌日对齐放在同一张可拖动因果图中。
desc.en: Put eccentricity, orbital phase, speed variation and transit alignment on one draggable causal map.

title.zh: 板块构造 · 边界如何留下证据
title.en: Plate Tectonics · How Boundaries Leave Evidence

desc.zh: 区分张裂、汇聚和转换边界，再把相对运动连到洋脊、海沟与地震证据。
desc.en: Distinguish divergent, convergent and transform boundaries, then connect relative motion to ridges, trenches and earthquake evidence.

title.zh: 气候能量账本 · 太阳光如何变成温度
title.en: Climate Energy Ledger · How Sunlight Becomes Temperature

desc.zh: 从纬度入射、表面反照到红外出射，沿着一束光走完整个气候能量链。
desc.en: Trace one beam through latitude, surface albedo and infrared escape to balance the climate energy ledger.

title.zh: 动量与碰撞 · 速度不是全部
title.en: Momentum & Collisions · Speed Is Not the Whole Story

desc.zh: 从 p = m·v 到 J = F·Δt，拖动质量、速度、力和时间，追踪碰撞守恒与安全停下的力。
desc.en: From p = m·v to J = F·Δt, tune mass, speed, force and time to trace collision conservation and safer stopping.

title.zh: 网络流 · 一封消息的旅程
title.en: Network Flow · A Message’s Journey

desc.zh: 从分包、延迟与带宽，到路由、TCP 握手和拥塞控制：一封消息如何穿过不可靠的网络，逐层拼成可靠的字节流。
desc.en: From packetization, latency and bandwidth to routing, TCP handshakes and congestion control: watch an unreliable network become a reliable byte stream layer by layer.

title.zh: 语音与音位 · 从口腔到对立
title.en: Speech Sounds & Phonemes · From Mouth to Contrast

desc.zh: 从发音动作、最小对立到音节槽位和复数同化，点击一个特征，追踪它怎样改变结构与意义。
desc.en: From articulation and minimal pairs to syllable slots and plural assimilation, change one feature and trace how structure and meaning move.

title.zh: 元音空间 · 用两个共振峰给元音定位
title.en: Vowel Space · Placing Vowels by Two Formants

desc.zh: 用 Peterson 与 Barney 1952 年的元音测量，看基频和共振峰的分工、10 个元音在 F1–F2 平面上的位置，以及为什么要先按说话人整体缩放才能认对。
desc.en: Using Peterson and Barney's 1952 vowel measurements, separate pitch from formants, place ten vowels on the F1–F2 plane, and see why rescaling by speaker comes before recognition.

title.zh: 气候反馈 · 一笔一笔对上能量账
title.en: Climate Feedback · Balance the Energy Ledger

desc.zh: 从 CO₂ 辐射强迫到冰雪、水汽和碳循环反馈，拖动旋钮追踪一条可检验的变暖因果链。
desc.en: Trace a testable warming chain from CO₂ forcing through ice, water-vapour and carbon-cycle feedbacks.

title.zh: 二维线性变换 · 矩阵如何挪动平面
title.en: 2D Linear Transformations · How Matrices Move the Plane

desc.zh: 拖动矩阵四个参数，观察网格、基向量、行列式面积和特征方向如何一起变化。
desc.en: Tune four matrix entries and watch the grid, basis vectors, determinant area and eigen-directions move together.

title.zh: 概率分布 · 随机性也有形状
title.en: Probability Distributions · Randomness Has a Shape

desc.zh: 在离散与连续分布之间切换，拖动参数，看概率质量、密度、均值与方差如何重排。
desc.en: Switch between discrete and continuous distributions, then tune parameters to see mass, density, mean and variance reorganize.

title.zh: 热力学 · 一口气追踪能量
title.en: Thermodynamics · Track Energy Through a Gas

desc.zh: 拖动活塞、切换等温与绝热过程，从 P–V 曲线面积走到第一定律和卡诺效率上限。
desc.en: Move the piston, compare isothermal and adiabatic paths, then connect P–V area to the first law and Carnot's efficiency ceiling.

title.zh: 缓冲溶液 · 把 pH 稳住
title.en: Buffer Capacity · Holding pH Steady

desc.zh: 调节酸碱加入量、浓度与 pKa，观察共轭对如何吸收扰动，以及缓冲容量何时耗尽。
desc.en: Tune acid/base additions, concentration and pKa to see a conjugate pair absorb disturbance and reveal when capacity runs out.

title.zh: 量子基础 · 可能性先于结果
title.en: Quantum Basics · Possibility Before Outcome

desc.zh: 从振幅、测量、相位到干涉，拖动一个量子比特的状态，观察概率如何先于结果出现。
desc.en: From amplitudes and measurement to phase and interference, tune one qubit and watch probability appear before the outcome.

title.zh: 数论与组合 · 把结构算出来
title.en: Number Theory & Counting · Compute the Structure

desc.zh: 用质因数分解、欧几里得算法、gcd/lcm 和 Pascal 行，把“数有多少种”变成可追踪的结构。
desc.en: Use prime factors, Euclid's algorithm, gcd/lcm and Pascal rows to turn counting into a traceable structure.

title.zh: 材料科学 · 应力如何变成断裂
title.en: Materials Science · When Stress Becomes Fracture

desc.zh: 比较钢、铝和工程塑料的应力–应变响应，追踪屈服、塑性、韧性和断裂的工程取舍。
desc.en: Compare steel, aluminium and polymer stress–strain responses, then trace the engineering trade-offs among yield, plasticity, toughness and fracture.

title.zh: 博弈论 · 先看对手会怎么选
title.en: Game Theory · Look at the Other Choice First

desc.zh: 在 2×2 收益矩阵里找最佳回应、占优策略和纳什均衡，再看混合策略如何把不确定性算出来。
desc.en: Use a 2×2 payoff matrix to find best responses, dominant strategies and Nash equilibria, then compute mixed-strategy uncertainty.

title.zh: 神经科学基础 · 从静息到脉冲
title.en: Neuroscience Basics · From Rest to Spike

desc.zh: 从 K⁺/Na⁺ 漏通道和静息电位走到阈值、全或无尖峰与不应期频率上限。
desc.en: Trace K⁺/Na⁺ leak balance into resting potential, threshold, all-or-none spikes and the refractory firing ceiling.

title.zh: 宇宙膨胀 · 空间本身在变大
title.en: Cosmic Expansion · Space Itself Gets Larger

desc.zh: 拖动尺度因子、哈勃常数和红移，沿着 d=aχ、v=H₀d、λ=(1+z)λ₀ 读懂膨胀宇宙。
desc.en: Tune the scale factor, Hubble constant and redshift to read an expanding universe through d=aχ, v=H₀d and λ=(1+z)λ₀.

title.zh: 分布式系统 · 多个副本如何像一个值
title.en: Distributed Systems · How Replicas Behave Like One Value

desc.zh: 拖动副本数、读写 quorum 和网络分区，观察复制、一致性与可用性如何互相牵制。
desc.en: Tune replica count, read/write quorums and partitions to see replication, consistency and availability trade-offs.

title.zh: 心理与认知 · 注意、记忆与干扰
title.en: Psychology & Cognition · Attention, Memory & Interference

desc.zh: 用工作记忆容量、注意瓶颈、提取线索和前摄/后摄干扰，理解“记不住”背后的可计算机制。
desc.en: Use working-memory capacity, attention bottlenecks, retrieval cues and proactive/retroactive interference to model why recall changes.

title.zh: 信号检测论 · 分得清，和愿意说“有”，是两回事
title.en: Signal Detection Theory · Telling Apart vs. Willing to Say “Yes”

desc.zh: 两位检测者都对了 80%，谁更会分辨？用命中率和虚报率把敏感度 d' 与判据 c 拆开，在 ROC 曲线上比较，再按错误代价选判据。
desc.en: Two detectors are both 80% correct — who discriminates better? Separate sensitivity d' from criterion c with hit and false-alarm rates, compare on the ROC curve, then pick a criterion by the cost of errors.

title.zh: 音乐理论 · 从音程到终止
title.en: Music Theory · From Intervals to Cadence

desc.zh: 从半音距离和频率比走到音阶级数、和弦功能与终止，建立可计算的听觉理论直觉。
desc.en: Move from semitone distance and frequency ratios to scale degrees, chord function and cadence with a computable theory intuition.

title.zh: 伦理决策 · 把取舍说清楚
title.en: Ethical Decisions · Make the Trade-off Visible

desc.zh: 用后果、权利、公平与同意四个镜头拆开决策，不替你给出道德或政策答案。
desc.en: Use consequences, rights, fairness and consent to unpack a decision without pretending to supply a moral or policy verdict.

title.zh: 无知之幕 · 不知道自己会是谁时，你选哪种社会
title.en: The Veil of Ignorance · Choosing a Society Before You Know Who You Will Be

desc.zh: 先选社会再抽位置：比较海萨尼的平均原则和罗尔斯的最大最小原则，用风险态度旋钮把两者接起来，再看拉平有代价时各选多大的再分配。
desc.en: Choose a society, then draw your position: compare Harsanyi's average rule with Rawls's maximin, connect them with a risk-attitude knob, and see how much redistribution each picks when levelling has a cost.

title.zh: 统计推断 · 从样本到判断
title.en: Statistical Inference · From Sample to Judgment

desc.zh: 从抽样分布走到置信区间、z 分数和 p 值，区分“数据有多不确定”和“假设有多不寻常”。
desc.en: Move from sampling distributions to confidence intervals, z-scores and p-values, separating data uncertainty from how unusual a hypothesis looks.

title.zh: 高阶机器人学 · 从角度到末端
title.en: Advanced Robotics · From Angles to the End Effector

desc.zh: 拖动平面二连杆的关节角，追踪正/逆运动学、Jacobian 速度映射与奇异位形。
desc.en: Tune a planar two-link arm and trace forward/inverse kinematics, Jacobian velocity mapping and singular configurations.

title.zh: 公共卫生 · 从曲线到干预
title.en: Public Health · From Curves to Interventions

desc.zh: 用传播曲线、R₀、检测指标与干预取舍，建立流行病学的教学模型直觉。
desc.en: Build an epidemiology intuition with epidemic curves, R₀, test metrics and intervention trade-offs.

title.zh: 计算机图形学 · 从坐标到画面
title.en: Computer Graphics · From Coordinates to Pixels

desc.zh: 拖动坐标变换、光栅化和漫反射，走完一条简化的 2D 渲染管线。
desc.en: Tune coordinate transforms, rasterization and diffuse shading through a compact 2D rendering pipeline.

title.zh: 机制设计与拍卖 · 报价如何改变结果
title.en: Mechanism Design & Auctions · How Bids Change Outcomes

desc.zh: 比较第一价与第二价拍卖，追踪赢家、付款和收益，理解规则如何塑造激励。
desc.en: Compare first- and second-price auctions, then trace winners, payments and utilities to see how rules shape incentives.

title.zh: 活化能 · 反应要翻过的那座山
title.en: Activation Energy · The Hill a Reaction Has to Climb

desc.zh: 反应物要先爬上一座能量山才能变成生成物：山多高、有多少分子爬得上去，决定了反应有多快。
desc.en: Reactants must climb an energy hill before they become products: how high the hill is, and how many molecules can climb it, decides how fast the reaction goes.

title.zh: 血液循环
title.en: Blood Circulation

desc.zh: 一滴血从左心室出发，先去全身再回心脏，再去肺里换气——两个环路接在同一颗心脏上，红和蓝只代表含氧量多少。
desc.en: A drop of blood leaves the left ventricle, visits the whole body, returns to the heart, then goes to the lungs — two loops on one heart, with red and blue showing only oxygen content.

title.zh: 浮力与阿基米德
title.en: Buoyancy & Archimedes

desc.zh: 把物体慢慢浸入水里，弹簧秤读数一路掉下去——掉的那部分恰好等于被它排开的水的重量。
desc.en: Lower an object into water and the spring scale reading keeps dropping — by exactly the weight of the water it pushes aside.

title.zh: 燃烧三要素
title.en: The Fire Triangle

desc.zh: 可燃物、氧气、够高的温度——三条腿缺一不可。灭火不是把火「打」死，而是把其中一条腿抽掉。
desc.en: Fuel, oxygen and enough heat: you need all three. Putting a fire out does not mean beating it — it means taking one leg away.

title.zh: 圆锥曲线
title.en: Conic Sections

desc.zh: 圆、椭圆、抛物线、双曲线看起来毫不相干，其实是同一个圆锥被不同角度的平面切出来的一家人，一个离心率 e 就能把它们连成一条线。
desc.en: Circle, ellipse, parabola and hyperbola look unrelated, yet they are one family cut from the same cone by planes at different angles — and a single number, the eccentricity e, strings them on one line.

title.zh: 等高线
title.en: Contour Lines

desc.zh: 地图上那些一圈圈的曲线，是把山体按相同高度一层层切开、再从正上方看下去的样子——圈越密的地方越陡。
desc.en: The rings on a map come from slicing a hill at equal heights and looking straight down: where the rings crowd together, the ground is steep.

title.zh: 密度
title.en: Density

desc.zh: 同样大的铁块和木块，天平一称就分出高下——「每立方厘米里装了多少质量」就是密度。
desc.en: An iron block and a wood block of the same size: one weighing tells them apart. Density is how much mass fits in each cubic centimetre.

title.zh: 溶解与饱和
title.en: Dissolution & Saturation

desc.zh: 一勺勺往水里加盐，开始全化掉，加到某个点再也不化——这个「装满」的状态叫饱和，它不是不动了，而是溶解和结晶一样快。
desc.en: Add salt to water spoon by spoon: at first it all disappears, then at some point it will not dissolve any more. That “full” state is saturation — not frozen, but dissolving and crystallising at the same speed.

title.zh: DNA 复制与翻译 · 拉链、抄写和流水线
title.en: DNA Replication and Translation · A Zipper, a Copy and an Assembly Line

desc.zh: 碱基像拉链两两配对；复制时每条链都当模板，抄写出 mRNA，核糖体再按密码子一格一格造出蛋白质。
desc.en: Bases pair up like a zipper; in replication each strand is a template, transcription copies a gene into mRNA, and the ribosome builds a protein codon by codon.

title.zh: 多普勒效应 · 驶近变尖，驶远变沉
title.en: The Doppler Effect · Higher as It Approaches, Lower as It Leaves

desc.zh: 一个发声的源在运动，波前被挤密或拉疏；从波前的间距算出听到的频率，再到掠过时的音调曲线和超音速的马赫锥。
desc.en: A sound source moves, and its wavefronts bunch up or stretch out; from the wavefront spacing work out the heard frequency, then the pitch curve of a pass-by and the Mach cone.

title.zh: 电场 · 看不见的力画成图
title.en: Electric Fields · Drawing an Invisible Force

desc.zh: 从一个点电荷的场出发，叠加、画场线、画等势面，最后放一个电荷看它怎么动。
desc.en: Start with one point charge, then add fields, draw field lines and equipotentials, and finally release a charge to watch it move.

title.zh: 电化学 · 电子沿导线跑，还是被电推着跑
title.en: Electrochemistry · Electrons Running Down the Wire, or Pushed Along

desc.zh: 氧化还原反应被拆成两个半电池：自发时电子沿导线流出电流（原电池），外加电压反推时就是电解池。
desc.en: A redox reaction is split into two half-cells: spontaneously it drives a current through the wire (a galvanic cell), and an applied opposing voltage turns it into an electrolytic cell.

title.zh: 电磁感应 · 磁通量一变，电压就来
title.en: Electromagnetic Induction · Change the Flux, Get a Voltage

desc.zh: 让磁铁穿过线圈，看磁通量的变化率怎样变成电压，再看楞次定律如何定方向、转动线圈如何发电。
desc.en: Pass a magnet through a coil, see how the rate of change of flux becomes a voltage, then how Lenz\

title.zh: 能量金字塔 · 为什么顶级捕食者那么少
title.en: The Energy Pyramid · Why Top Predators Are Rare

desc.zh: 阳光的能量一级一级往上传，每上一级只剩一成左右；顶级食肉动物为什么稀有、人吃素为什么养得活更多人，都能算出来。
desc.en: Sunlight\

title.zh: 酶 · 生物体内的催化剂
title.en: Enzymes · Catalysts of the Living World

desc.zh: 酶用一个形状合适的“口袋”把底物拉到一起，让反应在体温下就能飞快进行：从锁钥配合，到饱和、温度、pH 和抑制剂。
desc.en: An enzyme pulls substrates together in a pocket of the right shape so reactions run fast at body temperature: from lock-and-key fit to saturation, temperature, pH and inhibitors.

title.zh: 化学方程式配平
title.en: Balancing Chemical Equations

desc.zh: 化学反应不会凭空多出或消失原子，所以方程式两边每种原子数必须相等——配平就是调系数，把每杆小天平都调平。
desc.en: Reactions never create or destroy atoms, so every element must have equal counts on both sides — balancing means adjusting coefficients until every little scale is level.

title.zh: 食物网
title.en: Food Webs

desc.zh: 草、兔、狐连成网——吃与被吃把能量一层层往上送，网里任何一个结点变了，别处也会跟着变。
desc.en: Grass, rabbit, fox joined into a web — eating and being eaten passes energy up level by level, and a change at any node ripples to others.

title.zh: 同分异构体 · 同一组原子，不同的拼法
title.en: Isomers · The Same Atoms, Put Together Differently

desc.zh: 分子式相同、原子连接方式不同，就是不同的分子：数骨架、判断“画法不同还是分子不同”，再看单键与双键怎样让镜像般的异构体分得开。
desc.en: Same molecular formula, different connections between atoms, means different molecules: count the skeletons, tell "drawn differently" from "really different", and see why double bonds keep cis and trans apart.

title.zh: 气体压强的微观图景 · 撞墙的账本
title.en: The Microscopic Picture of Gas Pressure · A Ledger of Wall Hits

desc.zh: 盒子里的粒子乱撞：压强是撞墙的冲量账，温度是平均动能，速率分布自己从碰撞里长出来。
desc.en: Particles in a box bounce around: pressure is a ledger of wall impulses, temperature is mean kinetic energy, and the speed distribution grows out of collisions.

title.zh: 经纬网
title.en: Latitude & Longitude

desc.zh: 地球是个球，没有「上下左右」的格子——但只要说「北纬多少度、东经多少度」，就能在地球表面上定位任意一点。
desc.en: Earth is a sphere with no built-in grid — yet “so many degrees north, so many east” pins down any point on its surface.

title.zh: 磁场与洛伦兹力 · 力总是垂直于速度
title.en: Magnetic Force · The Force Is Always Sideways to the Velocity

desc.zh: 从一个带电粒子在磁场里“拐弯”出发，推出圆半径、周期，再用它称离子质量、挑选速度。
desc.en: Start with a charged particle bending in a magnetic field, derive its radius and period, then use them to weigh ions and pick out a speed.

title.zh: 减数分裂 · 洗牌、切半，造配子
title.en: Meiosis · Shuffle, Halve, Make Gametes

desc.zh: 染色体成对配对、交换片段、先分开同源染色体再分开姐妹染色单体：一个二倍体细胞变成四个互不完全相同的单倍体配子。
desc.en: Chromosomes pair up, swap pieces, first separate the homologs and then the sister chromatids: one diploid cell becomes four haploid gametes that are not all alike.

title.zh: 分子构型 · 电子对互相躲开
title.en: Molecular Shapes · Electron Pairs Keeping Out of Each Other\

desc.zh: 中心原子周围的电子对彼此排斥，自己排成最分散的队形；水为什么弯、甲烷为什么是正四面体，都从这里来。
desc.en: Electron pairs around a central atom repel one another and settle into the most spread-out arrangement; that is why water is bent and methane is a regular tetrahedron.

title.zh: 分子与原子
title.en: Molecules & Atoms

desc.zh: 水烧开、水通电都是「水变了」，可一个是分子换了位置，一个是分子被拆开重组——原子不变，分子才变。
desc.en: Boiling water and electrolysing water both “change the water”, but one only moves the molecules and the other tears them apart and rebuilds — atoms stay, molecules change.

title.zh: 自然选择 · 胡椒蛾的颜色为什么翻转
title.en: Natural Selection · Why the Peppered Moth Flipped Colour

desc.zh: 同一种蛾有浅色和深色两种；鸟看得见的先被吃掉，剩下的繁殖——树皮颜色一变，几代之后种群的颜色比例就跟着翻转。
desc.en: One species of moth comes in light and dark forms; birds eat what they can see, the survivors breed, and when the bark colour changes the colour ratio flips within a few generations.

title.zh: 找规律 · 不画也能报出第 100 个
title.en: Patterns · Name the 100th Without Drawing It

desc.zh: 用火柴棒摆图形：数出前几个，找到“每次多几根”，就能直接算出任意第 n 个。
desc.en: Build shapes from matchsticks: count the first few, find how many are added each time, then compute any figure n directly.

title.zh: 元素周期律 · 周期表上的渐变
title.en: Periodic Trends · Gradients Across the Periodic Table

desc.zh: 把原子半径、电离能、电负性涂成热图：沿周期、沿族有规律的渐变，由核电荷和电子层数解释，也有少数例外。
desc.en: Colour atomic radius, ionisation energy and electronegativity onto the table: they change in regular gradients along periods and groups, explained by nuclear charge and the number of shells, with a few exceptions.

title.zh: pH 标度
title.en: The pH Scale

desc.zh: 酸得多厉害、碱得多厉害，用一条 0 到 14 的刻度就能说清——pH 每差 1，酸碱的「劲」差 10 倍。
desc.en: How acidic or alkaline something is can be placed on one 0-to-14 ruler — and each step of 1 on it is a factor of 10.

title.zh: 光电效应 · 光是一份一份的
title.en: The Photoelectric Effect · Light Comes in Packets

desc.zh: 光照金属：频率不到门槛，再亮也打不出电子；过了门槛，电子的最大动能只随频率走，亮度只决定个数。
desc.en: Light on a metal: below a threshold frequency no electrons come out however bright it is; above it, the electrons\

title.zh: 压强
title.en: Pressure

desc.zh: 穿雪鞋不陷、图钉尖头易摁——同样的力，作用面积越小，压得越狠。「每单位面积上的压力」就是压强。
desc.en: Snowshoes keep you on top; a thumbtack tip goes in easily. The same force pressed on a smaller area pushes harder: force per unit area is pressure.

title.zh: 共振 · 踩中节拍，小推也能荡高
title.en: Resonance · Push in Time and a Small Force Goes a Long Way

desc.zh: 从弹簧的固有节拍出发，看阻尼怎样让振动衰减，再看周期性的推力在什么频率下把振幅推到最高。
desc.en: Start from a spring’s natural beat, see how damping makes oscillations die away, then find the driving frequency at which periodic pushes build the largest swing.

title.zh: 地球公转与四季
title.en: Earth’s Orbit & the Seasons

desc.zh: 夏天不是因为地球离太阳近，而是因为地轴斜着——绕太阳一圈，南北半球轮流把「脸」朝向太阳，昼夜长短也跟着轮流占上风。
desc.en: Summer is not because Earth is closer to the Sun, but because its axis is tilted: around the orbit the hemispheres take turns facing the Sun, and day length swings with them.

title.zh: 滴定曲线 · 终点附近 pH 的“悬崖”
title.en: Titration Curves · The pH Cliff Near the End Point

desc.zh: 往酸里一滴滴加碱：pH 先缓慢爬升，在等当点附近陡然跳升；指示剂变色要对准这个跳升。
desc.en: Add base to acid drop by drop: pH creeps up, then leaps near the equivalence point; the indicator must change colour right on that leap.

title.zh: 注意力机制 · 每个词决定看谁
title.en: Attention · Every Word Decides Where to Look

desc.zh: 从「查询与键的点积」到 softmax 权重、加权求和，再到整句的注意力矩阵：每个词怎样决定「看谁多一点」。
desc.en: From the dot product of query and key, through softmax weights and a weighted sum, to a whole-sentence attention matrix: how each word decides whom to look at.

title.zh: 平均数 · 移多补少
title.en: Averages · Level by Pouring

desc.zh: 高低不齐的水杯互相倒一倒，水位齐平的那个高度就是平均数。
desc.en: Pour water between uneven cups until they are level: the common level is the mean.

title.zh: 反向传播 · 误差沿网络回流
title.en: Backpropagation · Error Flows Back Through the Network

desc.zh: 输出错了，每个权重该负多少责任？用最小的网络，从「推一下看变化」走到链式法则、梯度下降，再看深层网络里梯度为什么会消失。
desc.en: When the output is wrong, how much blame does each weight carry? Use the smallest network to go from “nudge and see” to the chain rule and gradient descent, then see why gradients vanish in deep networks.

title.zh: 多臂老虎机 · 探索还是利用
title.en: Multi-Armed Bandits · Explore or Exploit

desc.zh: 五台看不出差别的机器，每台的中奖率你看不见：先亲手拉几次，再看贪心、ε-贪心、UCB 和汤普森采样怎样在「多试试」与「拉最好的」之间取舍。
desc.en: Five machines that look alike, each with a payout rate you cannot see: pull a few by hand, then watch greedy, ε-greedy, UCB and Thompson sampling trade off “try more” against “pull the best”.

title.zh: 条形图 · 让数字站成一排比高矮
title.en: Bar Charts · Numbers Standing in a Row

desc.zh: 一排柱子把数字变成长度：读得出谁高谁矮，也看得出平均线把高出和不足补平。
desc.en: A row of bars turns numbers into lengths: see who is taller, and watch the average line balance the highs against the lows.

title.zh: 鸡兔同笼 · 先假设，差额会说话
title.en: Chickens & Rabbits · Assume First, Let the Gap Speak

desc.zh: 知道头数和脚数，先假设“全是鸡”，多出来的脚恰好暴露了兔子有几只。
desc.en: Know the heads and the feet: assume they are all chickens, and the extra feet give away how many rabbits there are.

title.zh: 圆的认识 · 圆规、半径与 π
title.en: The Circle · Compass, Radius and π

desc.zh: 圆规一转画出圆；把圆周拉直量一量，周长总是直径的 3 倍多一点——这个倍数就是 π。
desc.en: A compass sweeps out a circle; unroll its edge and it is always a little over 3 diameters long: that multiple is π.

title.zh: 时钟与角度 · 两根针的赛跑
title.en: Clocks & Angles · A Race Between Two Hands

desc.zh: 时针慢、分针快：知道它们各转多快，就能算出任意时刻两针的夹角，也能找到它们重合的时刻。
desc.en: The hour hand is slow and the minute hand is fast: know how fast each turns and you can find the angle between them at any time, and when they overlap.

title.zh: 决策树与信息增益
title.en: Decision Trees and Information Gain

desc.zh: 每一刀都问一个是非题：怎样挑最能降低混乱度的那一刀，一刀接一刀长成一棵树，又为什么不能长得太深。
desc.en: Each cut asks a yes/no question: how to pick the cut that reduces disorder the most, grow a tree one cut at a time, and why it should not grow too deep.

title.zh: 词向量 · 把词摆成地图
title.en: Word Embeddings · Words as a Map

desc.zh: 一个词怎样变成一串数字？数字怎样衡量相似、做类比，机器又怎样不靠手工特征，从「常和谁在一起」里学出它们。
desc.en: How does a word become a list of numbers? How do the numbers measure similarity and solve analogies, and how can a machine learn them from “who a word keeps company with” instead of hand-made features?

title.zh: 浮与沉 · 排开的水托住了谁
title.en: Float & Sink · What the Displaced Water Holds Up

desc.zh: 同一块橡皮泥，捏成球会沉、捏成船会浮：决定浮沉的，是它排开了多少水。
desc.en: The same plasticine sinks as a ball but floats as a boat: what decides it is how much water it pushes aside.

title.zh: 不等式 · 天平倾斜，答案是一整段
title.en: Inequalities · A Tilted Scale Has a Whole Range of Answers

desc.zh: 天平不平的时候，答案不是一个数而是一段范围：在数轴上涂阴影，乘负数时要把不等号翻过来。
desc.en: When the scale tilts, the answer is a range, not one number: shade it on the number line, and flip the sign when you multiply by a negative.

title.zh: 间隔与植树 · 段数和点数差一
title.en: Intervals & Fences · Gaps and Posts Differ by One

desc.zh: 路边种树、锯木头、爬楼梯：数“点”和数“段”总是差一个，看清两头种不种就不会数错。
desc.en: Planting trees, sawing logs, climbing stairs: counting “points” and counting “gaps” differ by one, and checking the ends tells you which way.

title.zh: 反比例函数 · 此消彼长
title.en: Inverse Proportion · One Up, One Down

desc.zh: 长方形面积不变，长越长宽越矮；乘积不变的两个量，图像是一条永远碰不到坐标轴的双曲线。
desc.en: A rectangle of fixed area gets shorter as it gets longer; two quantities with a constant product graph as a hyperbola that never touches the axes.

title.zh: 大语言模型如何逐词生成
title.en: How an LLM Writes Word by Word

desc.zh: 每一步都是一张概率条：温度把它捏尖或摊平，top-k / top-p 砍掉长尾，再随机抽一个词，一个接一个写下去。
desc.en: Every step is a probability bar chart: temperature sharpens or flattens it, top-k and top-p trim the tail, then one word is drawn at random and appended, again and again.

title.zh: 磁铁 · 铁屑显出看不见的线
title.en: Magnets · Iron Filings Reveal Unseen Lines

desc.zh: 撒一层铁屑，磁感线自己显形：它们从 N 极出发、回到 S 极，同极相斥、异极相吸。
desc.en: Sprinkle iron filings and the field lines show themselves: they leave the N pole and return to the S pole; like poles repel, unlike poles attract.

title.zh: 平均数、中位数、众数之争 · 三个“平均”三个故事
title.en: Mean, Median, Mode · Three “Averages”, Three Stories

desc.zh: 同一组工资，三个“平均”说出三种故事；极端值一进来，只有中位数不慌。
desc.en: The same list of salaries, three “averages” and three stories; once an extreme value arrives, only the median stays calm.

title.zh: 月相 · 从地球看被照亮的那一半
title.en: Moon Phases · The Lit Half, Seen from Earth

desc.zh: 月亮永远有半边被太阳照亮；我们每晚看到多少，取决于它在轨道上跑到了哪里。
desc.en: Half the Moon is always lit by the Sun; how much of it we see each night depends on where it is on its orbit.

title.zh: 过拟合
title.en: Overfitting

desc.zh: 用多项式去拟合带噪声的点：曲线越灵活，训练误差越小，可没见过的数据上的误差却会先降后升。看清拐点，再看数据量、换批数据和正则化怎样改变它。
desc.en: Fit noisy points with a polynomial: the more flexible the curve, the smaller the training error, yet the error on unseen data first falls and then rises. Find the turning point, then see how data size, resampling and regularisation change it.

title.zh: PageRank · 随机冲浪者最后停在哪
title.en: PageRank · Where the Random Surfer Ends Up

desc.zh: 被链接得最多的网页就最重要吗？用一个随机冲浪者把「重要」变成概率，再用迭代算出来，看阻尼系数和一条新链接怎样改变排名。
desc.en: Is the most linked-to page the most important? Turn “important” into a probability with a random surfer, compute it by iteration, and see how the damping factor and one new link change the ranking.

title.zh: 位值与计数器 · 满十进一
title.en: Place Value & the Counting Frame · Ten Makes One

desc.zh: 同一个数字站在不同的位置，代表的大小差十倍、百倍：计数器上每一列的珠子满十就换成下一列的一颗。
desc.en: The same digit stands for ten or a hundred times more one place to the left: on a counting frame, ten beads in a column trade for one bead in the next.

title.zh: 多边形内角和 · 撕下来拼一拼
title.en: Polygon Angle Sums · Tear and Rearrange

desc.zh: 三角形的三个角拼在一起是平角 180°；任何多边形都能剖成三角形，内角和就是 (n − 2) × 180°。
desc.en: A triangle’s three angles fit together into a straight angle of 180°; any polygon can be cut into triangles, so its interior angles add up to (n − 2) × 180°.

title.zh: 概率与频率 · 转得越多，越贴近概率
title.en: Probability & Frequency · The More Spins, the Closer to the Probability

desc.zh: 一次转盘结果说不准，但转的次数越多，红色出现的频率就越稳定地围着它的概率打转。
desc.en: One spin cannot be predicted, but with more spins the frequency of red settles ever more steadily around its probability.

title.zh: 实数与数轴 · √2 落在哪一点
title.en: Real Numbers & the Number Line · Where √2 Lands

desc.zh: 把单位正方形的对角线转到数轴上，√2 就落在一个确定的点；它不能写成分数，却可以越逼越近。
desc.en: Swing the diagonal of a unit square onto the number line and √2 lands at one definite point; it cannot be written as a fraction, yet we can close in on it forever.

title.zh: 递归与分治 · 把大问题劈成小问题
title.en: Recursion and Divide-and-Conquer · Splitting a Big Problem Into Small Ones

desc.zh: 从函数调用自己，到汉诺塔、递归树和归并排序：为什么有的递归瞬间完成，有的一辈子也算不完。
desc.en: From a function calling itself to Towers of Hanoi, recursion trees and merge sort: why some recursions finish instantly and others could not finish in a lifetime.

title.zh: 相似与缩放 · 长度、面积、体积各变几倍
title.en: Similarity & Scaling · Lengths, Areas and Volumes Each Change Differently

desc.zh: 投影仪把图像放大 k 倍：边长变 k 倍，面积变 k² 倍，体积变 k³ 倍，而形状和角度不变。
desc.en: A projector enlarges a picture k times: lengths grow k times, areas k² times, volumes k³ times, while shape and angles stay the same.

title.zh: 简单电路 · 电流要走一圈
title.en: Simple Circuits · Current Must Go Round

desc.zh: 电池、开关和灯泡连成一个完整的圈，灯才会亮；断开一处，整圈的电流同时停下。
desc.en: A battery, a switch and a bulb joined into one complete loop make the bulb light; break it anywhere and the current stops all round at once.

title.zh: 二元一次方程组 · 两条直线的交点
title.en: Simultaneous Equations · Where Two Lines Meet

desc.zh: 一个方程有无数个解，再加一个方程就把解“钉”在两条直线的交点上；代入和加减是把它算出来的两种办法。
desc.en: One equation has endless solutions; a second equation pins the answer to where two lines cross. Substitution and elimination are two ways to calculate it.

title.zh: 声音从振动来 · 米粒会跳的鼓
title.en: Sound from Vibration · A Drum with Jumping Rice

desc.zh: 敲一下鼓，鼓面来回振动，鼓面上的米粒跳起来：声音就是物体的振动通过空气传到耳朵。
desc.en: Strike a drum and the drumhead vibrates, tossing the rice on it: sound is an object’s vibration carried through the air to your ear.

title.zh: 三视图 · 三张影子拼回立体
title.en: Three Views · Three Shadows Rebuild a Solid

desc.zh: 把积木从正面、侧面、上面各看一眼，得到三张平面图；三张图对齐起来，就能还原出立体的样子。
desc.en: Look at a stack of blocks from the front, the left and above to get three flat pictures; line them up and you can rebuild the solid.

title.zh: 水的循环 · 一滴水的旅行
title.en: The Water Cycle · One Drop’s Journey
