desc.zh: 太阳晒海、水汽上升成云、雨落回山、河流入海：水在海洋、空气和陆地之间不断流动，但总量不变。
desc.en: The Sun warms the sea, vapour rises into cloud, rain falls on the hills and rivers run to the sea: water moves between ocean, air and land, but the total stays the same.

title.zh: 小波 · 让窗口随频率伸缩
title.en: Wavelets · Windows That Stretch With Frequency

desc.zh: 傅里叶谱说得出「有哪些频率」，说不出「何时」。从加窗口、到让窗口随频率伸缩，再到用最少的数描述突变。
desc.en: A Fourier spectrum says which frequencies are present, but not when. Add a window, let the window stretch with frequency, then describe sharp changes with very few numbers.

title.zh: 哈希 · 把任意输入压成固定指纹
title.en: Hashing · Squeezing Any Input Into a Fixed Fingerprint

desc.zh: 任意长度的输入变成固定长度的指纹：雪崩效应、哈希表里的冲突、生日悖论，以及指纹到底要多少位才够。
desc.en: Any-length input becomes a fixed-length fingerprint: the avalanche effect, collisions in hash tables, the birthday paradox, and how many bits a fingerprint really needs.

title.zh: 极限与 ε–δ · 你说多近，我就能多近
title.en: Limits and ε–δ · Name How Close, and I Can Get That Close

desc.zh: 把“无限接近”变成一场有规则的博弈：对方先给出 ε（允许的误差），你要找出 δ（x 离 a 多近就够了）。
desc.en: Turn "gets arbitrarily close" into a game with rules: the opponent gives ε (the allowed error) and you must find δ (how close x must be to a).

title.zh: 大气环流与季风 · 风从哪里来
title.en: Atmospheric Circulation & Monsoons · Where Winds Come From

desc.zh: 赤道多晒、极地少晒，空气因此转圈；地球自转把圈拧成三圈和信风，陆海温差又让风随季节掉头。
desc.en: The equator gets more sun than the poles, so air turns over in loops; Earth’s spin twists them into three cells and trade winds, and land–sea contrast flips the wind with the season.

title.zh: 拍卖 · 报价与真话
title.en: Auctions · Bidding and Telling the Truth

desc.zh: 同一件东西，四种拍法：为什么第二价格拍卖里说真话最划算，而第一价格拍卖里要“压价”？
desc.en: One item, four auction rules: why is telling the truth best in a second-price auction, while a first-price auction makes you shade your bid?

title.zh: 二项分布到正态 · 钉板上长出的钟形
title.en: Binomial to Normal · The Bell Curve Growing on a Pegboard

desc.zh: 小球在钉板上一层层向左或向右，落点的柱状图随层数增加，越来越像那口钟。
desc.en: A ball goes left or right at every peg; as the rows increase, the histogram of landing bins looks more and more like the bell.

title.zh: 黑体辐射 · 热的物体为什么发光
title.en: Blackbody Radiation · Why Hot Things Glow

desc.zh: 温度越高，颜色从红变白再变蓝；经典理论在紫外一端失败，普朗克的“能量一份一份”把它救了回来。
desc.en: Hotter things glow from red to white to blue; classical theory fails in the ultraviolet, and Planck’s idea that energy comes in lumps rescues it.

title.zh: 碳循环 · 大气里的碳去了哪里
title.en: The Carbon Cycle · Where the Atmosphere’s Carbon Goes

desc.zh: 用五个“碳库”的账本，看自然流转为什么平衡、一点点人为排放为什么会累积，又为什么停止排放后降得很慢。
desc.en: A ledger of five carbon reservoirs shows why natural flows balance, why a small extra emission accumulates, and why the atmosphere falls slowly after emissions stop.

title.zh: 卡诺循环 · 热机的效率上限
title.en: The Carnot Cycle · The Ceiling on Heat-Engine Efficiency

desc.zh: 在 p–V 图上走完四步一圈，净功就是围出的面积；效率只由热源和冷源两个温度决定。
desc.en: Four steps around a p–V loop: the net work is the enclosed area, and the efficiency depends only on the hot and cold temperatures.

title.zh: 混沌与三体 · 初始差一丝，结果天壤
title.en: Chaos and the Three-Body Problem · Tiny Differences, Huge Outcomes

desc.zh: 规则完全确定，结果却无法长期预测：从一个迭代公式，到洛伦兹的蝴蝶，再到三颗星的追逐。
desc.en: The rules are fully deterministic, yet long-term prediction fails: from a one-line map to Lorenz’s butterfly to three stars chasing each other.

title.zh: 卷积神经网络的特征图 · 小窗口怎样“看”图
title.en: CNN Feature Maps · How a Small Window “Sees” an Image

desc.zh: 一个 3×3 的小窗口在图上滑动，边缘、模糊、锐化各是一组数字；把它们堆起来，再让机器自己学出这组数字。
desc.en: A 3×3 window slides across an image; edges, blur and sharpening are just different sets of nine numbers. Stack them, then let the machine learn the numbers itself.

title.zh: 复利与贴现 · 时间是钱的形状
title.en: Compound Interest & Discounting · Time Is the Shape of Money

desc.zh: 利息也生利息，钱就按倍数生长；反过来，未来的钱折成今天的价值，就是贴现。
desc.en: When interest earns interest, money grows by multiples; run it backwards and a future amount is worth less today, which is discounting.

title.zh: 排列与组合 · 数清楚有多少种
title.en: Permutations & Combinations · Counting How Many Ways

desc.zh: 分步计数画成树，排列与组合只差一句话：顺序算不算数。
desc.en: Count in steps and draw the tree; permutations and combinations differ by one sentence: does the order matter?

title.zh: 双缝实验 · 一颗一颗的粒子，也走出干涉条纹
title.en: The Double-Slit Experiment · Single Particles Still Build Fringes

desc.zh: 一颗一颗发射电子，条纹自己长出来；一旦知道它走了哪条缝，条纹就消失。
desc.en: Fire particles one at a time and fringes grow by themselves; the moment you know which slit one took, the fringes vanish.

title.zh: 期望 · 彩票、骰子、保险放在同一台秤上
title.en: Expected Value · Lotteries, Dice and Insurance on One Scale

desc.zh: 期望是长期平均的公平价：用它判断一次下注值不值，也看清为什么买保险明知吃亏还值得。
desc.en: Expected value is the fair price of a long-run average: use it to judge a bet, and to see why insurance can be worth buying even at a loss on average.

title.zh: 外部性与公地悲剧 · 账记在谁头上
title.en: Externalities & the Tragedy of the Commons · Who Pays the Bill

desc.zh: 工厂排污的代价落在别人身上，市场就会多生产；庇古税、产权与协商是把这笔账拉回价格里的几种办法。
desc.en: When a factory’s pollution costs fall on others, the market produces too much; a Pigouvian tax, property rights and bargaining are ways to pull that bill back into the price.

title.zh: 眼睛与眼镜 · 为什么近视要戴凹透镜
title.en: The Eye and Glasses · Why Short-Sightedness Needs a Concave Lens

desc.zh: 眼睛是一台自带变焦的照相机：晶状体把光聚在视网膜上；聚到视网膜前面就是近视，凹透镜把焦点推回去。
desc.en: The eye is a camera with a built-in zoom: the lens focuses light on the retina; when focus lands in front of it you are short-sighted and a concave lens pushes it back.

title.zh: 引力透镜 · 宇宙里的凸透镜
title.en: Gravitational Lensing · A Cosmic Convex Lens

desc.zh: 大质量天体弯曲时空，路过的光跟着偏折：遥远光源被放大、分成两个像，甚至拉成一个光环。
desc.en: A massive object bends spacetime and passing light follows: a distant source is magnified, split into two images, even smeared into a ring.

title.zh: 万有引力与轨道 · 横着扔出去，会落下、绕圈还是飞走
title.en: Gravity and Orbits · Throw It Sideways: Fall, Circle or Escape

desc.zh: 平方反比的引力加上一点横向速度：轨道从坠落变成椭圆、圆，再到逃逸；开普勒三定律从模拟里自己浮现。
desc.en: An inverse-square pull plus some sideways speed: the path turns from a crash into an ellipse, a circle, then an escape; Kepler’s three laws emerge from the simulation.

title.zh: 假设检验与 p 值 · 法庭模型判硬币冤不冤
title.en: Hypothesis Testing & p-Values · A Courtroom for a Coin

desc.zh: 先假定硬币公平（无罪推定），再问“如果公平，出现这么极端的结果有多罕见”；显著性水平是愿意冤枉好人的预算。
desc.en: Presume the coin is fair (innocent until proven guilty), then ask how rare a result this extreme would be if it were; the significance level is the budget for convicting an innocent coin.

title.zh: 马尔可夫链 · 下一步只看现在
title.en: Markov Chains · The Next Step Depends Only on Now

desc.zh: 天气、网页浏览、赌徒的本金：只要“明天只取决于今天”，转移矩阵的幂次里就会浮现一个稳态。
desc.en: Weather, web browsing, a gambler’s fortune: whenever “tomorrow depends only on today”, a steady state emerges from the powers of the transition matrix.

title.zh: 机械能守恒 · 过山车的能量账本
title.en: Conservation of Mechanical Energy · The Roller Coaster’s Energy Ledger

desc.zh: 动能和重力势能此消彼长、总数不变；一旦有摩擦，少掉的机械能变成热，账本照样是平的。
desc.en: Kinetic and gravitational potential energy trade off while the total stays fixed; add friction and the missing mechanical energy shows up as heat, so the ledger still balances.

title.zh: 牛顿运动定律 · F = ma 是调出来的
title.en: Newton’s Laws of Motion · F = ma, Tuned by Hand

desc.zh: 在斜面和平地上推箱子：受力箭头与加速度实时对账，F=ma 不是背出来的，是调出来的。
desc.en: Push a box on ice, on a rough floor and on a ramp: the force arrows and the acceleration stay in step, so F = ma is something you tune, not memorise.

title.zh: 牛顿法求根 · 沿切线一刀跳向零点
title.en: Newton’s Method · Leap to the Root Along a Tangent

desc.zh: 用切线代替曲线，每一刀都把误差的位数翻倍；失败的几种情形也画给你看。
desc.en: Replace the curve by its tangent and jump to where the tangent hits zero; each jump roughly doubles the correct digits. The ways it fails are drawn too.

title.zh: 微分方程相图 · 捕食者与猎物的回路
title.en: ODE Phase Portraits · Predators and Prey in a Loop

desc.zh: 兔子与狐狸此消彼长：时间曲线看过程，相平面看全貌，每条轨线是一种命运。
desc.en: Rabbits and foxes rise and fall together: time curves show the story, the phase plane shows the whole picture, and each trajectory is a fate.

title.zh: 欧姆定律 · 电流是调出来的
title.en: Ohm’s Law · Current You Tune by Hand

desc.zh: 电压推、电阻挡：I = U/R 不是背的，是在滑杆上一格一格调出来的。
desc.en: Voltage pushes, resistance holds back: I = V/R isn’t something to memorise but something you tune on a slider.

title.zh: 泊松过程 · 随机到达的规律
title.en: The Poisson Process · The Pattern in Random Arrivals

desc.zh: 放射性计数、排队来人：事件随机到达，却有精确的统计规律——间隔是指数分布，窗口里的个数是泊松分布。
desc.en: Radioactive counts, people joining a queue: arrivals are random yet follow exact statistics — gaps are exponential, counts per window are Poisson.

title.zh: 囚徒困境与演化博弈 · 合作怎样活下来
title.en: The Prisoner’s Dilemma & Evolutionary Games · How Cooperation Survives

desc.zh: 一次博弈里背叛划算；重复博弈、种群演化里，“以牙还牙”式的合作可以活下来——条件是什么，页面里一格一格调出来。
desc.en: In a one-shot game, defecting pays; in repeated games and evolving populations tit-for-tat style cooperation can survive — and the page lets you tune the conditions.

title.zh: 抛体与圆周 · 一直在掉，但总掉不到地上
title.en: Projectiles & Circular Motion · Always Falling, Never Landing

desc.zh: 把速度劈成水平、竖直两份，各走各的；圆周运动需要不停“拽向圆心”；卫星就是水平速度大到掉下去的曲线总绕着地球转的炮弹。
desc.en: Split velocity into a horizontal and a vertical part that do not disturb each other; circular motion needs a steady pull toward the centre; a satellite is a cannonball whose fall keeps curving round the Earth.

title.zh: 量子隧穿 · 穿墙的是概率，不是子弹
title.en: Quantum Tunnelling · What Passes Through the Wall Is a Probability

desc.zh: 波撞上能量更高的墙：大部分被反弹，一小撮穿了过去——扫描隧道显微镜就靠这一小撮。
desc.en: A wave hits a wall higher than its energy: most of it bounces back and a small share gets through — and the scanning tunnelling microscope runs on that small share.

title.zh: 回归与相关 · 散点云里拉一条最贴的线
title.en: Regression & Correlation · The Best Line Through a Cloud

desc.zh: 一堆点，一条线，一个数：相关系数 r 说“多贴”，最小二乘线说“怎么贴最好”，还有几个让人上当的陷阱。
desc.en: A cloud of points, a line and a number: the correlation r says how tightly they follow, the least-squares line says how best to fit them, and a few traps that fool people.

title.zh: 狭义相对论 · 同时性的线倾斜了
title.en: Special Relativity · The Lines of “Now” Tilt

desc.zh: 光速对谁都一样，于是时间会变慢、长度会缩短、“同时”变得因人而异——时空图把这些画给你看。
desc.en: The speed of light is the same for everyone, so clocks run slow, lengths shrink and “at the same time” depends on who is looking — a spacetime diagram draws it all.

title.zh: 风险池化与保险 · 一万人各摊一点
title.en: Risk Pooling & Insurance · Ten Thousand People Each Chip In

desc.zh: 个人遇到的是 0 或 10000 元的赌局；一万人合在一起，却变成一笔几乎可以预先算好的账——大数定律的商业形态，以及它失灵的地方。
desc.en: One person faces a gamble of $0 or $10,000; ten thousand together face an account that can be worked out ahead of time — the law of large numbers as a business, and where it fails.

title.zh: RSA 公钥加密 · 乘起来容易，拆开来难
title.en: RSA Public-Key Encryption · Easy to Multiply, Hard to Split

desc.zh: 把两个大质数相乘只要一步，从乘积倒推两个质数却要天文数字的步数——这种不对称，让“公开的锁、私藏的钥匙”成为可能。
desc.en: Multiplying two big primes takes one step; recovering them from the product takes an astronomical number — and that asymmetry makes a public lock and a private key possible.

title.zh: 地震波探地心 · 地核是被波“照”出来的
title.en: Seismic Waves · The Core Was “Lit Up” by Waves

desc.zh: 地震发出的 P 波和 S 波一前一后到达；它们在地球里拐弯、被挡住的方式，让人从没去过的地核有了名字、大小和状态。
desc.en: An earthquake sends out P and S waves that arrive one after the other; how they bend and get blocked inside the Earth gave the core — which nobody has visited — a size, a name and a state.

title.zh: 数列与求和 · 叠砖与棋盘麦粒
title.en: Sequences & Series · Stacked Bricks and Chessboard Grains

desc.zh: 叠砖每层多一块是等差，棋盘麦粒每格翻倍是等比；倒序相加当场拼出求和公式，等比求和则告诉你“无限多项”能不能有尽头。
desc.en: Bricks with one more per layer are arithmetic, grains that double per square are geometric; add a row backwards to build the sum formula on the spot, and see whether infinitely many terms can add up.

title.zh: 串联与并联 · 电流的分与合
title.en: Series & Parallel · Splitting and Merging Current

desc.zh: 一条河上两个水闸首尾相接是串联，河水分成两条支流再汇合是并联——电流和电压分别怎样分？粒子流速画出来。
desc.en: Two sluice gates on one river end to end are in series; a river that splits into two branches and rejoins is in parallel — how do current and voltage divide? The flowing dots show it.

title.zh: 最短路 · 从起点像洪水一样漫开
title.en: Shortest Path · Flooding Out From the Start

desc.zh: 迪杰斯特拉算法每次“确认”离起点最近的那个点：最短路径是被“漫到”的顺序逼出来的；也看它怎样在带权地图上绕开泥地，以及什么时候会出错。
desc.en: Dijkstra’s algorithm “settles” the nearest node at a time: the shortest paths are forced out by the order in which the flood reaches things; see how it detours around mud on a weighted map and when it breaks.

title.zh: 立体几何 · 转一转，再切一刀
title.en: Solid Geometry · Turn It, Then Cut It

desc.zh: 把立方体转到不同角度看，用平面一刀切下去，截面从三角形变成六边形；体积与表面积怎样随尺寸变化，展开图又能不能折回立方体。
desc.en: View a cube from different angles, then slice it with a plane and watch the cross-section go from triangle to hexagon; see how surface area and volume scale and whether a net folds back into a cube.

title.zh: 声音是波 · 看见自己的声音
title.en: Sound Is a Wave · Seeing Your Own Voice

desc.zh: 声音是空气一疏一密的传播：音调管波形的疏密，响度管振幅，音色管波形的形状；速度、波长、频率用 v = fλ 连在一起。本页不播放声音，只画波。
desc.en: Sound is a pattern of squeezing and loosening carried through air: frequency sets how close the pattern is, amplitude the loudness, and the wave’s shape the timbre; v = fλ ties speed, wavelength and frequency together. This page plays no sound, it only draws the waves.

title.zh: 泰勒级数 · 把曲线一项项贴上去
title.en: Taylor Series · Patch the Curve Term by Term

desc.zh: 多项式一项项加上去，曲线在一点附近被逐段贴合到重合；这是“局部”的逼近，与傅里叶“整体”的逼近恰成对照。
desc.en: Add a polynomial term by term and the curve gets matched ever farther around one point; this is a “local” approximation, the counterpart of Fourier’s “global” one.

title.zh: 向量 · 有方向的量
title.en: Vectors · Quantities With a Direction

desc.zh: 力的合成是箭头首尾相接，坐标里加法就是分量各自相加；点积让两个箭头“投影”出一个数。
desc.en: Combining forces is joining arrows head to tail; in coordinates, addition just adds the components; the dot product turns two arrows’ “projection” into a number.

title.zh: 股票与债券 · 买到的到底是什么
title.en: Stocks & Bonds · What Do You Actually Buy

desc.zh: 买股票是买下公司的一小份所有权，买债券是借钱给它收利息；公司出问题时，债主先、股东后。
desc.en: Buying a stock buys a small slice of ownership; buying a bond lends money for interest — and if the company fails, lenders are paid before shareholders.

title.zh: 风险与回报 · 为什么风险大承诺回报高
title.en: Risk & Return · Why Do Riskier Things Usually Promise More

desc.zh: 波动大的东西必须承诺更高回报才有人愿意承担；但承诺不等于到手，分布比平均数更诚实。
desc.en: Volatile options must promise more to attract takers — but a promise is not a payout; the distribution is more honest than the average.

title.zh: 分散投资 · 为什么不把鸡蛋放一个篮子里
title.en: Diversification · Why Not Put All Eggs in One Basket

desc.zh: 组合波动看的是资产之间的相关性，不是数量；十只同涨同跌的资产约等于一只。
desc.en: A portfolio's wobble depends on how its assets move together, not how many there are; ten assets moving as one behave like one.

title.zh: 费率与复利 · 1% 的费率怎么吃掉回报
title.en: Fees & Compounding · How Does a 1% Fee Eat Returns

desc.zh: 费率从收益率里扣，1% 乘上 30 年复利，能吃掉约四分之一终值。
desc.en: A fee comes out of the return every year; 1% compounded over 30 years eats roughly a quarter of the final value.

title.zh: 利率与债券 · 利率升为什么债价跌
title.en: Interest Rates & Bonds · Why Do Bond Prices Fall When Rates Rise

desc.zh: 债券是一串未来现金流，利率升了、折现重了，老债券就必须降价才卖得掉。
desc.en: A bond is a stream of future cash; when rates rise, discounting gets heavier, so an old bond must drop in price to sell.

title.zh: 投资知识地图
title.en: Investment Atlas

desc.zh: 投资的 12 个概念、22 条联系、5 条问题路线：从基础概念、市场与工具、风险、估值到行为，沿问题链走进对应的交互讲解。
desc.en: 12 investment concepts, 22 connections, 5 question routes across foundations, markets, risk, valuation, and behavior — follow a question into its interactive lesson.
